| [Deform3DGS: Flexible Deformation for Fast Surgical Scene Reconstruction with Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.17835) (2024)<br><br><sub>monocular-reconstruction &middot; monocular &middot; endoscopy-surgery &middot; fast-training &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; real-time</sub> | <ol><li>Flexible Deformation Modeling (FDM): per-Gaussian motion curves for position, rotation and scale as weighted sums of Gaussian basis functions of time with learnable centers and variances, no MLP (main.tex:150-175).</li><li>Motion-aware point fusion (MAPF): stereo-depth point clouds from multiple frames are fused to initialize the Gaussians densely under instrument occlusion (main.tex:212-220).</li><li>Reported 64 s training and 338 fps rendering on EndoNeRF on one RTX A5000, versus 138 s and 128 fps for EndoGaussian measured on the same hardware (main.tex:271-285, 387).</li></ol> |
| [MoSca: Dynamic Gaussian Fusion from Casual Videos via 4D Motion Scaffolds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.17421) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://jiahuilei.com/projects/mosca/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/JiahuiLei/MoSca "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>monocular-reconstruction &middot; monocular &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; tracking &middot; unposed &middot; depth-prior</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces 4D Motion Scaffolds, a compact and smooth representation of motion and deformation for casual monocular video.</li><li>Disentangles geometry and appearance from deformation by globally fusing Gaussians anchored to the motion scaffold.</li><li>Solves focal length and camera poses through bundle adjustment without external pose-estimation tools.</li></ol> |
| [Vidu4D: Single Generated Video to High-Fidelity 4D Reconstruction with Dynamic Gaussian Surfels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.16822) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://vidu4d-dgs.github.io "Project page")<br><sub>monocular-reconstruction &middot; monocular &middot; per-scene &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; surface-gaussian &middot; generation</sub> | <ol><li>Dynamic Gaussian Surfels: a time-varying bone-based SE(3) warping, blended with dual-quaternion skinning, that moves 2D Gaussian surfels from a static state to a per-frame warped state (main.tex:141-160).</li><li>Warped-state normal regularization computed from the continuous warping field, plus learned per-surfel rotation and scale refinements that reduce texture flicker (main.tex:168, 199).</li><li>A field-initialization stage: a bone-warped neural SDF supplies camera poses and the warping field that start DGS.</li></ol> |
| [Dynamic Gaussians Mesh: Consistent Mesh Reconstruction from Dynamic Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.12379) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://www.liuisabella.com/DG-Mesh "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Isabella98Liu/DG-Mesh "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>monocular-reconstruction &middot; monocular &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; dataset-release</sub> | <ol><li>DG-Mesh: canonical 3D Gaussians deformed per frame, converted each frame to a mesh by differentiable Poisson surface reconstruction and differentiable Marching Cubes, giving time-consistent meshes with vertex tracking.</li><li>Gaussian-Mesh Anchoring: mesh-guided densification and pruning that merges Gaussians sharing a nearest face and pulls each Gaussian to its face, so Gaussians spread evenly on the surface.</li><li>Cycle-consistent forward/backward deformation that maps anchored Gaussians back to canonical space, plus a released synthetic DG-Mesh dataset with per-frame ground-truth meshes.</li></ol> |
| [BAGS: Building Animatable Gaussian Splatting from a Monocular Video with Diffusion Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.11427) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://talegqz.github.io/BAGS/ "Project page")<br><sub>monocular-reconstruction &middot; monocular &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; per-scene &middot; real-time &middot; large-model</sub><br><sub>⚠ unverified: experiments</sub> | <ol><li>BAGS builds an animatable 3D Gaussian model from one casual monocular video using neural-bone LBS without a parametric template (sections/2_intro.tex:23; sections/4_method.tex:70-99).</li><li>ImageDream score distillation supplies unseen-view supervision, and an SVD-based rigid regulariser on the deformation Jacobian keeps the priors from distorting motion (sections/4_method.tex:123-140).</li><li>A 40-video in-the-wild animal collection is used to compare against BANMo on CLIP similarity, training time and rendering speed (sections/5_exp.tex:17,45-49).</li></ol> |
| [Endo-4DGS: Endoscopic Monocular Scene Reconstruction with 4D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.16416) (2024)<br><br>[![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/lastbasket/Endo-4DGS "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>monocular-reconstruction &middot; monocular &middot; per-scene &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; depth-prior &middot; endoscopy-surgery</sub> | <ol><li>Represents deformable endoscopic tissue as 4D Gaussians: a static 3DGS plus a HexPlane-encoded deformation decoded by five tiny MLPs into offsets of position, rotation, scale, opacity and SH.</li><li>Initializes Gaussians from Depth-Anything pseudo-depth backprojected through the tool mask, removing the need for ground-truth or stereo depth.</li><li>Adds confidence-guided depth and color losses, a surface-normal constraint from the shortest Gaussian axis, and Pearson-gradient depth regularization against the depth prior.</li></ol> |
| [EndoGaussians: Single View Dynamic Gaussian Splatting for Deformable Endoscopic Tissues Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.13352) (2024)<br><br><sub>monocular-reconstruction &middot; monocular &middot; rgb-d &middot; per-scene &middot; depth-prior &middot; endoscopy-surgery</sub><br><sub>⚠ unverified: experiments</sub> | <ol><li>Applies per-frame Dynamic 3D Gaussians to single-view RGBD endoscopic video after removing surgical tools with a flow-guided video inpainting model.</li><li>Initializes Gaussians from a dense RGBD-backprojected point cloud and trains with differentiable depth rasterization, L1 depth loss and rigid/rotation/isometry losses.</li><li>Renders a hallucination map supervised by an L1 loss against tool masks to flag reconstructed regions that were never observed.</li></ol> |
| [EndoGaussian: Real-time Gaussian Splatting for Dynamic Endoscopic Scene Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.12561) (2024)<br><br><sub>monocular-reconstruction &middot; endoscopy-surgery &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; real-time &middot; fast-training &middot; depth-prior</sub> | <ol><li>Holistic Gaussian Initialization: depth maps from a stereo (binocular) or Depth Anything (monocular) estimator are re-projected with known intrinsics/extrinsics, tool-masked, and merged across all frames to seed the Gaussians without COLMAP.</li><li>Spatio-temporal Gaussian Tracking: a HexPlane encoding voxel over (x,y,z,t) feeds four tiny MLPs predicting per-Gaussian offsets of position, rotation, scale and opacity, with SH left static.</li><li>On ENDONERF the binocular model reports 37.849 PSNR at 195 FPS with 2 minutes training and 2 GB GPU memory on one RTX 4090, against hours for EndoNeRF and EndoSurf.</li></ol> |
| [EndoGS: Deformable Endoscopic Tissues Reconstruction with Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.11535) (2024)<br><br>[![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/HKU-MedAI/EndoGS "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>monocular-reconstruction &middot; monocular &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; robotics &middot; endoscopy-surgery</sub> | <ol><li>Applies deformable Gaussian splatting to monocular endoscopic tissue reconstruction.</li><li>Combines deformation fields, depth-guided spatiotemporal masks, and surface-aligned regularization to handle tool occlusion and recover tissue geometry.</li></ol> |
| [GauFRe: Gaussian Deformation Fields for Real-Time Dynamic Novel View Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.11458) (2023)<br><br><sub>monocular-reconstruction &middot; monocular &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; real-time &middot; per-scene</sub> | <ol><li>Forward-warping deformation field: an MLP maps canonical Gaussian position, rotation, scale and time to per-Gaussian deltas, with quaternion multiplication and pre-exponentiated scale updates.</li><li>A separately densified static Gaussian set is concatenated with the deformed set at render time, freeing deformation capacity for moving regions.</li><li>Real-time monocular dynamic view synthesis: 34.5 PSNR on D-NeRF (400x400) in 13 minutes of training, 96 FPS on NeRF-DS on one RTX 3090.</li></ol> |
| [CoGS: Controllable Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.05664) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://cogs2024.github.io "Project page")<br><sub>monocular-reconstruction &middot; monocular &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; editing &middot; per-scene</sub> | <ol><li>Dynamic Gaussian Splatting from a monocular camera: per-attribute deformation MLPs predict time-conditioned offsets of Gaussian mean, color, rotation and scale.</li><li>Local difference and local-rigidity losses regularise Gaussian trajectories so neighbouring Gaussians move consistently over time.</li><li>Controllable GS: 3D masks, unsupervised PCA-derived control signals and per-signal offset networks let users manipulate scene parts without pre-computed control signals.</li></ol> |
| [Neural Parametric Gaussians for Monocular Non-Rigid Object Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.01196) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://geometric-rl.mpi-inf.mpg.de/npg/ "Project page")<br><sub>monocular-reconstruction &middot; monocular &middot; per-scene &middot; deformable-3dgs</sub><br><sub>⚠ unverified: experiments</sub> | <ol><li>A two-stage template-free monocular pipeline: stage one fits a coarse point model whose per-frame geometry is a low-rank combination of K learnable point bases with MLP-predicted coefficients, and stage two reconstructs under that constraint.</li><li>A local Gaussian representation: each coarse point and its 19 nearest neighbours form an oriented volume, and every Gaussian parameter is shared across time, so the coarse model alone deforms the Gaussians.</li><li>Novel-view synthesis reported on the D-NeRF benchmark at 400x400 and 800x800 and on the Unbiased4D synthetic cactus, the paper's low-multi-view-cue target setting.</li></ol> |
| [Deformable 3D Gaussians for High-Fidelity Monocular Dynamic Scene Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.13101) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://ingra14m.github.io/Deformable-Gaussians/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/ingra14m/Deformable-3D-Gaussians "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>monocular-reconstruction &middot; monocular &middot; per-scene &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; real-time</sub> | <ol><li>Learns 3D Gaussians in canonical space with a deformation field for monocular dynamic-scene reconstruction.</li><li>Introduces annealing smoothing during training to reduce the effect of inaccurate poses on time interpolation.</li><li>Uses a differential Gaussian rasterizer for high-quality, real-time dynamic rendering.</li></ol> |

## Feed-forward 4DGS and world models

Methods that reconstruct, generate, encode, or compress a dynamic Gaussian representation in a
learned forward pass, rather than optimizing a new representation from scratch for every sequence.

| **[New]** [4DGS-WAM: Bridging Past and Future with an Object-Centric World Action Model based on 4D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.25956) (2026)<br><br><sub>feed-forward &middot; world-model &middot; driving &middot; explicit &middot; depth-prior</sub><br><sub>⚠ unverified: experiments, method</sub> | <ol><li>An object-centric world action model that decomposes a dynamic scene into a persistent static Gaussian bank and per-object dynamic Gaussians, so future prediction transports only the dynamic splats.</li><li>A time-conditioned policy over object and ego centre trajectories predicts target-horizon SE(3) actions in one evaluation, and a GotenNet-style geometric tensor world model turns them into per-splat transforms.</li></ol> |
| [GaussianDream++: Efficient 3D Gaussian World Modeling for Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.25659) (2026)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://tuojingai.github.io/GaussianDream-Series-project-page/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/TuojingAI/GaussianDream "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>feed-forward &middot; multi-view &middot; robotics &middot; world-model</sub><br><sub>⚠ unverified: experiments</sub> | <ol><li>Embeds 16 World State Tokens and 4 World Prediction Tokens directly in the PaliGemma prefix, replacing GaussianDream's dense VGGT/TGE-built 1024-token prefix (sec/3._method.tex:62-78, 142-147).</li><li>A training-only World Representation Head decodes those tokens into a rendered Current World and horizon-indexed future Gaussian states built as per-primitive residual centres under a static-dynamic motion gate (sec/3._method.tex:260-311).</li><li>Head, renderer and auxiliary objectives are dropped at deployment, so inference adds only the 20 world tokens and moves action-chunk latency from 286 ms to 330 ms (sec/3._method.tex:393-403; sec/4._experiments.tex:555-565).</li></ol> |

| [L4GM: Large 4D Gaussian Reconstruction Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.10324) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://research.nvidia.com/labs/toronto-ai/l4gm/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/nv-tlabs/L4GM-official "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>feed-forward &middot; monocular &middot; large-model &middot; native-4dgs &middot; generation</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces a large reconstruction model that produces animated objects from single-view video in one feed-forward pass.</li><li>Builds a curated multiview animated-object training dataset derived from Objaverse assets.</li><li>Extends LGM with temporal self-attention and an interpolation model to produce temporally smoother per-frame Gaussian representations.</li></ol> |
| [Tele-Aloha: A Low-budget and High-authenticity Telepresence System Using Sparse RGB Cameras](https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.14866) (2024)<br><br><sub>feed-forward &middot; human &middot; sparse-view &middot; real-time</sub><br><sub>⚠ unverified: experiments</sub> | <ol><li>Tele-Aloha: a bidirectional telepresence system using four sparse RGB cameras, one RTX 4090 and an autostereoscopic screen, rendering upper-body views at 2048x2048, 30 fps and under 150 ms latency.</li><li>A cascaded disparity estimator gives robust geometry; foreground pixels are lifted to pixel-aligned latent Gaussians and rasterized to the target view with a differentiable Gaussian splatting rasterizer, then decoded.</li><li>Weighted blending of source views refines the decoded low-resolution image to 2K; outperforms FloRen, ENeRF and GPS-Gaussian on a synthetic sparse-view dataset (PSNR 26.543).</li></ol> |
| [ManiGaussian: Dynamic Gaussian Splatting for Multi-task Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.08321) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://guanxinglu.github.io/ManiGaussian/ "Project page")<br><sub>feed-forward &middot; segmentation &middot; human &middot; robotics</sub> | <ol><li>ManiGaussian mines scene dynamics via future scene reconstruction for multi-task robotic manipulation.</li><li>Formulates the dynamic Gaussian Splatting framework that infers the semantics propagation in the Gaussian embedding space, where the semantic representation is leveraged to predict the optimal robot action.</li><li>Builds a Gaussian world model to parameterize the distribution in the dynamic Gaussian Splatting framework, which provides informative supervision in the interactive environment via future scene reconstruction.</li></ol> |

</details>

<details>
<summary>Detailed contributions (114 papers)</summary>

| Paper (arXiv) | Key contributions |
| --- | --- |
| [PhysMAS: Physics-Grounded Multi-Agent Synthesis of Compositional 4D Gaussians](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07174) (2026)<br><br><sub>generation &middot; physics-aware &middot; explicit &middot; multi-view &middot; large-model</sub><br><sub>⚠ unverified: experiments, method</sub> | <ol><li>Every scene Gaussian carries a compound object--part row, lifted object-first then within-object from four calibrated views and held fixed through material proposal, particle compilation and rendering (sections/method.tex:21-35).</li><li>A two-agent contract: the scene agent alone owns identity, planning and acceptance, the material agent returns row-wise profiles inside the accepted simulator-profile domain, and compilation, simulation, repair and ranking stay deterministic (sections/method.tex:40-54, 175).</li><li>A bounded candidate-and-repair loop executes every object in one shared MPM grid and screens execution records against a fixed validity gate and threshold, avoiding per-scene SDS backpropagation (sections/method.tex:145-175).</li></ol> |
| [GradRig: Differentiable Weights for Skinned Gaussian Splat Deformation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05127) (2026)<br><br><sub>generation &middot; editing &middot; real-time &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; explicit</sub><br><sub>⚠ unverified: datasets, experiments, method</sub> | <ol><li>Stores the spatial gradient of each skinning weight as a per-splat attribute and adds an elastic term to the covariance transform, so splats stretch with their neighbours and stop opening holes under skinned deformation (main.tex:163-174).</li><li>Obtains those weight gradients by auto-differentiating the screen-space selection operations a user performs to author the weights, instead of estimating them post hoc from splat neighbours (main.tex:207-231).</li><li>Adds an optional post-process that adaptively splits splats whose second-order Taylor term exceeds a threshold, using a scene-agnostic precomputed dictionary of 16k splat decompositions with L=5 (main.tex:258-291).</li></ol> |

| [Diffusion4D: Fast Spatial-temporal Consistent 4D Generation via Video Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.16645) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://vita-group.github.io/Diffusion4D "Project page")<br><sub>generation &middot; synthetic &middot; dataset &middot; large-model</sub> | <ol><li>Diffusion4D: a 4D-aware video diffusion model, trained on a curated dynamic 3D dataset from Objaverse-1.0/XL, that synthesizes spatially and temporally consistent orbital views of a dynamic asset from text, image or static 3D prompts.</li><li>A 3D-to-4D motion magnitude metric for controlling dynamic strength, a motion magnitude reconstruction loss, and 3D-aware classifier-free guidance to refine motion learning and generation.</li><li>Explicit coarse-to-fine 4D Gaussian Splatting construction from the generated orbital views yields 4D assets in about 8 minutes, beating 4DFY, Animate124, 4DGen and STAG4D on CLIP scores and user preference.</li></ol> |
| **[New]** [GSDeformer: Direct, Real-time and Extensible Cage-based Deformation for 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.15491) (2024)<br><br><sub>generation &middot; explicit &middot; editing</sub><br><sub>⚠ unverified: datasets, experiments, links, method, resources</sub> | <ol><li>Construct a deformation cage, deform proxy points sampled from each Gaussian, transfer the deformation to Gaussian parameters, and split Gaussians where bending requires greater local detail.</li><li>The evaluation includes Quantitative comparison on the quality of the generated cage.</li></ol> |
| [D-MiSo: Editing Dynamic 3D Scenes using Multi-Gaussians Soup](https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.14276) (2024)<br><br>[![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/waczjoan/D-MiSo "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>generation &middot; editing &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; per-scene</sub> | <ol><li>Multi-Gaussians: a large flat Core-Gaussian carrying motion parameterises many small Sub-Gaussians, whose centres are trainable offsets in its local frame and which alone are rendered (arxive.tex:345-357, arxive.tex:369-389).</li><li>Two networks give the dynamics: a Deform Network moves the Core triangle vertices and rotation with time; a Sub-Rot Network adds a per-Sub-Gaussian rotation update (arxive.tex:599-607, arxive.tex:648-653).</li><li>Three post-training editing routes over the Triangle Soup: an Alpha-Shape mesh, direct Sub-Triangle edits, or a space transform; the paper calls editing its main contribution (arxive.tex:763-767, arxive.tex:826-828).</li></ol> |
| [SimEndoGS: Efficient Data-driven Scene Simulation using Robotic Surgery Videos via Physics-embedded 3D Gaussians](https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.00956) (2024)<br><br><sub>generation &middot; physics-aware &middot; endoscopy-surgery &middot; explicit &middot; per-scene</sub><br><sub>⚠ unverified: experiments</sub> | <ol><li>Reconstructs a tool-occlusion-free surgical scene as 3D Gaussians from stereo endoscopic video, with stereo-depth supervision and anisotropy regularization so the Gaussians are geometrically plausible for simulation.</li><li>Pads Gaussians behind the tissue surface using an opacity field on a 100^3 grid, then runs Material Point Method simulation directly on the Gaussians (positions as MPM particles, covariance updated by the deformation gradient).</li><li>Uses a Neo-Hookean constitutive model so Young's modulus and Poisson ratio control tissue stiffness; reports about one minute of training and 20-25 simulation fps per scene on an RTX 3090.</li></ol> |
| [GSTalker: Real-time Audio-Driven Talking Face Generation via Deformable Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.19040) (2024)<br><br><sub>generation &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; real-time &middot; driving &middot; human</sub> | <ol><li>Trains in 40 minutes and renders audio-driven talking faces at 125 FPS from a short person-specific video.</li><li>Uses an audio-driven Gaussian deformation field with multi-resolution hash-grid tri-planes and temporal smoothing.</li></ol> |
| [PhysDreamer: Physics-Based Interaction with 3D Objects via Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.13026) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://physdreamer.github.io/ "Project page")<br><sub>generation &middot; physics-aware &middot; multi-view &middot; per-scene</sub> | <ol><li>PhysDreamer estimates a spatially varying Young's modulus field for a static 3D Gaussian object by matching differentiable MPM simulation renders to a video generated by Stable Video Diffusion.</li><li>A two-stage optimization of initial velocity then material field, both parameterized by triplanes with MLPs and total-variation regularization, with per-frame L1 plus D-SSIM losses.</li><li>A subsampling scheme that simulates K-means driving particles and interpolates Gaussian positions and rotations, evaluated by a 100-participant 2AFC user study against PhysGaussian, DreamGaussian4D and real captures.</li></ol> |
| [SC4D: Sparse-Controlled Video-to-4D Generation and Motion Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.03736) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://sc4d.github.io/ "Project page")<br><sub>generation &middot; monocular &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; per-scene</sub><br><sub>⚠ unverified: experiments</sub> | <ol><li>SC4D, a video-to-4D generation framework in which sparse control points with a time-conditioned MLP drive dense 3D Gaussians via LBS, decoupling motion from appearance.</li><li>Adaptive Gaussian initialization and a Gaussian Alignment loss that keep coarse-stage shape and motion from degenerating during fine-stage texture refinement.</li><li>A motion-transfer application: learned control-point motion is re-used to synthesize new 4D objects from text prompts with a depth-conditioned ControlNet.</li></ol> |
| [Feature Splatting: Language-Driven Physics-Based Scene Synthesis and Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.01223) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://feature-splatting.github.io "Project page")<br><sub>generation &middot; editing &middot; physics-aware &middot; segmentation &middot; multi-view &middot; per-scene</sub><br><sub>⚠ unverified: experiments</sub> | <ol><li>Appends a view-independent feature vector to every 3D Gaussian and distils SAM-mask-pooled CLIP features into it, regularised by a DINOv2 branch weighted 0.1 (main.tex:157-192).</li><li>GS-Taichi-MPM animates a language-selected object's Gaussians over simulation time, preserving volume with transparent in-filled particles and rotating covariances by nearest-neighbour plane normals rather than deformation gradients (main.tex:220-231).</li><li>Material properties, collision surfaces and gravity are grounded from open-text queries: rigid-material vocabularies select rigid particles, and RANSAC fits planes to Gaussians matching floor and tabletop queries (main.tex:212-219).</li></ol> |
| [STAG4D: Spatial-Temporal Anchored Generative 4D Gaussians](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.14939) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://nju-3dv.github.io/projects/STAG4D/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/zeng-yifei/STAG4D "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>generation &middot; monocular &middot; per-scene &middot; deformable-3dgs</sub> | <ol><li>Initializes 4D generation with multi-view diffusion applied to input video frames and anchors temporal self-attention to the first frame for consistency.</li><li>Optimizes a dynamic Gaussian point cloud with score distillation and an adaptive densification strategy designed to stabilize Gaussian gradients.</li><li>Accepts text, image, or video inputs without training or fine-tuning the underlying diffusion networks.</li></ol> |
| [GaussianFlow: Splatting Gaussian Dynamics for 4D Content Creation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.12365) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://zerg-overmind.github.io/GaussianFlow.github.io/ "Project page")<br><sub>generation &middot; per-scene &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; editing</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces Gaussian flow, connecting 3D Gaussian dynamics to pixel velocities between consecutive frames.</li><li>Obtains Gaussian flow by splatting Gaussian dynamics into image space.</li><li>Targets 4D generation and novel-view synthesis, including reduced color drifting in 4D generation.</li></ol> |
| [Mesh-based Gaussian Splatting for Real-time Large-scale Deformation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.04796) (2024)<br><br><sub>generation &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; real-time &middot; driving &middot; human</sub> | <ol><li>Enables interactive deformation directly on Gaussian-splatting scenes.</li><li>Uses a large-scale Gaussian deformation technique to enable deformable GS, which alters the parameters of 3D Gaussians according to the manipulation of the associated mesh.</li><li>Achieves reconstruction and effective deformation, while maintaining the promising rendering results at a high frame rate(65 FPS on average).</li></ol> |
| [VR-GS: A Physical Dynamics-Aware Interactive Gaussian Splatting System in Virtual Reality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.16663) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://yingjiang96.github.io/VR-GS/ "Project page")<br><sub>generation &middot; multi-view &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; real-time &middot; segmentation &middot; editing</sub> | <ol><li>Combines a two-level embedding with deformable-body simulation for real-time physics-aware interaction in VR.</li><li>Also incorporates real-time deformation embedding and dynamic shadow casting, ensuring a comprehensive and engaging virtual experience.</li></ol> |
| [Gaussian Splashing: Unified Particles for Versatile Motion Synthesis and Rendering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.15318) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://gaussiansplashing.github.io/ "Project page")<br><sub>generation &middot; multi-view &middot; per-scene &middot; physics-aware &middot; editing</sub><br><sub>⚠ unverified: experiments</sub> | <ol><li>Unifies 3D Gaussian Splatting with position-based dynamics so reconstructed solids and fluids are simulated as particles and rendered as Gaussians in one framework.</li><li>Transfers PBD particle displacements and deformation gradients onto trained Gaussian kernels with generalized moving least squares, and renders fluids as normal-augmented Gaussians with specular shading.</li></ol> |
| [Efficient4D: Fast Dynamic 3D Object Generation from a Single-view Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.08742) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://fudan-zvg.github.io/Efficient4D/ "Project page")<br><sub>generation &middot; native-4dgs &middot; monocular &middot; fast-training &middot; real-time</sub> | <ol><li>A generate-then-reconstruct video-to-4D pipeline: SyncDreamer-T, a SyncDreamer variant with a time-synchronous spatial volume, produces a view-by-time image matrix that is fitted directly by native 4D Gaussian splatting.</li><li>An inconsistency-aware confidence-weighted loss that scales RGB and SSIM terms per generated image by agreement with optical-flow interpolations from neighbouring frames, plus a lightly weighted SDS term.</li><li>About 10 minutes per object on one A6000 (2 min generation, 8 min reconstruction) versus 120 min for Consistent4D, with CLIP 0.92 and LPIPS 0.13 on the seven synthetic Consistent4D sequences.</li></ol> |
| [4DGen: Grounded 4D Content Generation with Spatial-temporal Consistency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.17225) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://vita-group.github.io/4DGen/ "Project page")<br><sub>generation &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; monocular &middot; per-scene &middot; hybrid</sub><br><sub>⚠ unverified: experiments</sub> | <ol><li>Grounded video-to-4D generation: a monocular video (user-captured or produced by an image-to-video diffusion model) specifies appearance and motion, so image-to-4D and text-to-4D reduce to video-to-4D.</li><li>A static set of 3D Gaussians deformed by a multi-resolution HexPlane field, warmed up on SyncDreamer multi-view pseudo labels at anchor frames and refined with 3D-aware SDS plus total-variation and temporal-acceleration smoothness losses.</li><li>On 13 front-view test videos, 4DGen reports lower CLIP and CLIP-T distances and higher X-CLIP scores than per-frame DreamGaussian, One-2-3-45 and Consistent4D, training about one hour on one RTX3090.</li></ol> |
| [DreamGaussian4D: Generative 4D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.17142) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://jiawei-ren.github.io/projects/dreamgaussian4d/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/jiawei-ren/dreamgaussian4d "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>generation &middot; monocular &middot; per-scene &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; fast-training</sub> | <ol><li>Builds image-to-4D content by generating a static Gaussian model with DreamGaussianHD and then optimizing HexPlane-driven Gaussian deformation.</li><li>Refines UV-space texture maps with a pretrained image-to-video diffusion model to improve detail and temporal consistency.</li><li>Reduces per-asset optimization to minutes, supports visual motion control, and exports animated meshes for conventional 3D engines.</li></ol> |
| [SC-GS: Sparse-Controlled Gaussian Splatting for Editable Dynamic Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.14937) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://yihua7.github.io/SC-GS-web/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/CVMI-Lab/SC-GS "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>generation &middot; per-scene &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; editing &middot; explicit</sub> | <ol><li>Decomposes dynamic-scene motion and appearance into sparse control points and dense Gaussians.</li><li>Learns compact 6-DoF transformation bases that are interpolated locally to produce Gaussian motion fields.</li><li>Adapts control-point locations and counts and applies an ARAP loss for spatial continuity and local rigidity.</li></ol> |
| [Align Your Gaussians: Text-to-4D with Dynamic 3D Gaussians and Composed Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.13763) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://research.nvidia.com/labs/toronto-ai/AlignYourGaussians/ "Project page")<br><sub>generation &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; per-scene</sub> | <ol><li>Text-to-4D with dynamic 3D Gaussians: a static Gaussian object plus an MLP deformation field Delta_Phi(x,y,z,tau) that displaces Gaussians over time.</li><li>Compositional score distillation: MVDream multiview, text-to-image and a custom text-to-video latent diffusion model jointly supervise geometry, appearance and motion in two stages.</li><li>JSD regularisation of the Gaussian distribution over time, a motion amplifier on video scores, and autoregressive deformation-field interpolation for longer sequences.</li></ol> |
| [GAvatar: Animatable 3D Gaussian Avatars with Implicit Mesh Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.11461) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://nvlabs.github.io/GAvatar "Project page")<br><sub>generation &middot; human &middot; real-time &middot; per-scene</sub> | <ol><li>Primitive-based Gaussian avatar: Gaussians live in the local frames of SMPL-X-attached cubic primitives and move with pose via P_k, R_k, S_k, giving animation for free.</li><li>Implicit attribute and SDF fields predict Gaussian colour, rotation, scale and opacity from canonical position, stabilising SDS optimisation of millions of Gaussians.</li><li>SDF-to-opacity kernel plus DMTet mesh extraction regularise geometry and yield textured meshes; user study over 24 prompts prefers GAvatar over six text-to-avatar baselines.</li></ol> |
| [Gaussian Shell Maps for Efficient 3D Human Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.17857) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://rameenabdal.github.io/GaussianShellMaps/ "Project page")<br><sub>generation &middot; human &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; real-time</sub><br><sub>⚠ unverified: experiments</sub> | <ol><li>A 3D GAN whose StyleGAN2 generator emits an N-layer, 11-channel texture stack read by 3D Gaussians anchored at fixed barycentric positions on shells inflated and deflated from an SMPL template.</li><li>Articulation inherited from SMPL: deforming the shells moves and rotates every Gaussian by barycentric and skinning-quaternion interpolation, used during GAN training and to pose generated humans; PCK 99.48 and 99.27 top their columns.</li><li>Native 512x512 adversarial training without an upsampler on single-view images: FID 15.78 on DeepFashion and 13.30 on SHHQ, second lowest in each column, at 28 ms/img, tied with StylePeople for lowest inference time.</li></ol> |
| [PhysGaussian: Physics-Integrated 3D Gaussians for Generative Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.12198) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://xpandora.github.io/PhysGaussian/ "Project page")<br><sub>generation &middot; physics-aware &middot; editing &middot; real-time &middot; explicit</sub><br><sub>⚠ unverified: experiments</sub> | <ol><li>Continuum-mechanics kinematics for 3D Gaussians: under a first-order local affine approximation a transported kernel stays Gaussian, giving x_p(t) = phi(X_p, t) and a_p(t) = F_p(t) A_p F_p(t)^T (main.tex:242-275).</li><li>A unified simulation-rendering pipeline: an explicit MPM adopted from Zong et al. evolves the same Gaussians that are splatted, with spherical harmonics rotated by the polar factor of F_p (main.tex:283-300, supplemental.tex:6-35).</li><li>Opacity-field internal filling, an anisotropy regulariser, and a synthesised three-scene bend/twist benchmark on which the method leads three NeRF baselines and three ablations in all six PSNR columns (main.tex:311-337, 374-418).</li></ol> |
| [Control4D: Efficient 4D Portrait Editing With Text](https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.20082) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://control4darxiv.github.io/ "Project page")<br><sub>generation &middot; editing &middot; human &middot; multi-view &middot; deformable-3dgs</sub><br><sub>⚠ unverified: experiments</sub> | <ol><li>GaussianPlanes: a 4D representation that structures Gaussian Splatting by predicting per-Gaussian attributes from a spatial tri-plane and deforming a canonical Gaussian cloud with a flow decoded from Tensor4D-style 4D plane decomposition.</li><li>A 4D generator that couples GaussianPlanes with a GAN super-resolution module so that inconsistent per-image edits from a diffusion editor supervise a continuous generative space instead of being fitted directly.</li><li>Control4D, a text-driven 4D portrait editing framework with multi-level guidance and staged static-then-dynamic training, evaluated by FID and CLIP similarity on multi-view portrait videos.</li></ol> |

## Dynamic tracking, segmentation, and SLAM

This section covers persistent point tracking, motion scaffolds, 4D scene understanding, and
dynamics-aware mapping. Some reconstruction papers are repeated because tracking is a primary
output of the method.

| [Query Rewriting for Complex Object Segmentation in 4D Gaussian Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.02664) (2026)<br><br><sub>tracking-slam &middot; segmentation &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; large-model</sub><br><sub>⚠ unverified: experiments, method</sub> | <ol><li>A training-free, multi-level query-rewriting front end that compresses verbose narrative queries into keyword-anchored forms and leaves the underlying 4D LangSplat architecture and its trained Gaussian fields unmodified (mainLNCS.tex:125, 166-172).</li><li>A keyword-injection mechanism in which a lightweight LLM extracts open-vocabulary keywords from object-level captions and sorts them into a Subject / State / Deformation triple matching the base model's dual semantic fields (mainLNCS.tex:186-189).</li><li>An evaluation on four HyperNeRF and four Neu3D scenes with LLM-generated verbose queries, reporting average temporal accuracy 60.92 -&gt; 92.21, average vIoU 20.08 -&gt; 76.94 and average Neu3D mIoU 57.37 -&gt; 75.25 (mainLNCS.tex:265-274, 297-298).</li></ol> |
| [SplatCtrl: Perception-Action Coupling via Gaussian Scene Representations and Reactive Robot Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.08948) (2026)<br><br><sub>tracking-slam &middot; rgb-d &middot; multi-view &middot; online &middot; real-time &middot; robotics</sub><br><sub>⚠ unverified: experiments</sub> | <ol><li>It extends 3D Gaussian Splatting with voxel-based filtering and dynamic Gaussian relocation, adding, removing and repositioning isotropic Gaussians under a fixed budget so the map follows a changing workspace (root.tex:158-159).</li><li>It derives a continuous signed distance function from isotropic Gaussians by extending a Gaussian process distance field to carry radii, with a log-domain stabilisation and a mass-lumped approximation (root.tex:167-172, root.tex:243-262).</li><li>It couples that distance field into a QP-IK controller as a control barrier function, validated in simulation, on a Franka FR3, and in a pilot human-robot shared-workspace study (root.tex:265-279, root.tex:387).</li></ol> |
| [Track2Map: Online Deformable SLAM with Motion-Aware Pose Optimization in Robotic Surgery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.08408) (2026)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://track2map.github.io/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/styufo/Track2Map "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>tracking-slam &middot; slam &middot; online &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; tracking &middot; endoscopy-surgery</sub> | <ol><li>Track2Map jointly optimizes camera trajectory and 3D deformable scene representation directly from surgical video.</li><li>Introduces a track-anchored deformation initialization using dense 2D point tracks.</li><li>Improved reconstruction quality and camera trajectory against competing SLAM methods, as well as compared to non-SLAM methods that utilize camera trajectory priors.</li></ol> |
| [DeGenseGS: Geometrically and Semantically Decoupled Surgical Scene Understanding in 4D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04761) (2026)<br><br>[![Non-functional or unverified GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-8c959f?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/yimowwwww/DeGenseGS "Placeholder or documentation-only GitHub repository")<br><sub>tracking-slam &middot; per-scene &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; segmentation &middot; endoscopy-surgery</sub> | <ol><li>Uses shared HexPlane kinematic latents to synchronize semantic evolution with scene dynamics while decoupling semantics from geometric deformation.</li><li>Optimizes semantic features in their hyperspherical latent space to preserve semantic-anatomic alignment under tissue deformation and topology changes.</li></ol> |
| [Streaming Gaussian Encoding for 4D Panoptic Occupancy Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30754) (2026)<br><br>[![Non-functional or unverified GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-8c959f?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://sge.cs.uni-freiburg.de "GitHub repository status not verified")<br><sub>tracking-slam &middot; driving &middot; tracking &middot; online &middot; streaming &middot; multi-view</sub> | <ol><li>A streaming Gaussian encoder that keeps a fixed-budget set of latent Gaussian queries alive across timesteps for camera-based 4D panoptic occupancy tracking, giving representation-level temporal coherence.</li><li>Confidence- and visibility-guided state management: Gaussian opacity, shaped by depth-splatting supervision against sparse LiDAR, is accumulated over time to prune and refresh queries under a budget of K=8192.</li><li>Feature-aware ego-motion compensation and a warmup-based multi-frame training scheme; new state of the art on Occ3D-nuScenes (STQ 34.4) and Occ3D-Waymo (STQ 21.9) with about 2% throughput cost.</li></ol> |
| [CubifyGS: Object-Centric 3D Gaussian Splatting for Lifelong Dynamic Scene Maintenance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28720) (2026)<br><br><sub>tracking-slam &middot; rgb-d &middot; online &middot; tracking &middot; robotics &middot; explicit</sub> | <ol><li>Movable instances are reusable Gaussian assets: a rearranged object is re-posed by transforming its own Gaussian means and covariances, not re-optimized from scratch (chapters/3_methods.tex:42-51).</li><li>Spatio-temporal perception detects appearance by IoU association and disappearance by ray-cast occupancy, then an event-triggered strategy reweights the 3DGS loss onto the changed ROI (chapters/3_methods.tex:59-90,130-151).</li><li>A Blender benchmark of four 1000-frame rearrangement sequences; CubifyGS holds the best value in all fifteen columns of the five-sequence comparison (chapters/4_experiment.tex:19-24,118-128).</li></ol> |
| [Multi4D: High-Fidelity Dynamic Gaussian Splatting via Multi-Level Competitive Allocation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22197) (2026)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://batfacewayne.github.io/Multi4D.io/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/BatFaceWayne/Multi4D "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>multi-view-reconstruction &middot; per-scene &middot; hybrid &middot; tracking &middot; segmentation</sub> | <ol><li>Represents a dynamic scene with static, persistent, and transient Gaussian subsets tailored to different temporal behaviors.</li><li>Exposes persistent Gaussians as stable primitives for efficient segmentation and tracking in addition to novel-view synthesis.</li></ol> |
| [Intrinsic 4D Gaussian Segmentation from Scene Cues](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.18623) (2026)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://kurbanintelligencelab.github.io/intrinsic-gs/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/intrinsic-gs "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>tracking-slam &middot; per-scene &middot; segmentation</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces a training-free and mask-free method for recovering object-level structure directly from 4D Gaussian primitives.</li><li>Builds a sparse affinity graph from appearance, orientation, scale, deformation trajectories, and rendered-boundary cues.</li><li>Partitions the graph with Leiden community detection, avoiding foundation models and learned feature fields while improving segmentation efficiency.</li></ol> |
| [PersistGS: Differentiable Physics for Object Permanence in 4D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03479) (2026)<br><br><sub>tracking-slam &middot; multi-view &middot; explicit &middot; physics-aware &middot; tracking</sub> | <ol><li>Couples per-object Gaussians and collision meshes to differentiable rigid-body simulation for fully occluded motion.</li><li>Estimates friction and velocity before occlusion and uses the simulated SE(3) trajectory to preserve object permanence.</li><li>Introduces a centroid-silhouette loss that isolates positional gradients from appearance noise.</li></ol> |
| [Learning Global Motion with Compact Gaussians for Feed-Forward 4D Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31595) (2026)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://cvlab-kaist.github.io/C4G/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/cvlab-kaist/C4G "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>feed-forward &middot; monocular &middot; unposed &middot; tracking &middot; native-4dgs</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces timestamp-conditioned learnable Gaussian query tokens that aggregate full temporal context for feed-forward 4D reconstruction.</li><li>Decodes Gaussians whose positions are modulated by target time.</li><li>Extends feature aggregation to a 4D feature field for point tracking and dynamic scene understanding, with video-diffusion rendering enhancement.</li></ol> |
| [Flow4DGS-SLAM: Optical Flow-Guided 4D Gaussian Splatting SLAM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.22339) (2026)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://wangys16.github.io/Flow4DGS-SLAM/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/wangys16/Flow4DGS-SLAM "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>tracking-slam &middot; slam &middot; tracking &middot; rgb-d &middot; native-4dgs &middot; fast-training</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces optical-flow-guided dynamic 3DGS SLAM for reconstructing static and dynamic regions.</li><li>Uses ego-motion fitting to derive category-agnostic motion masks and flow-guided camera-pose initialization.</li><li>Models dynamic Gaussian centers at keyframes with scene-flow propagation, plus temporal opacity and rotation with a Gaussian mixture model.</li></ol> |
| [GEAR: GEometry-motion Alternating Refinement for Articulated Object Modeling with Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07728) (2026)<br><br>[![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/VIPL-VSU/GEAR "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>tracking-slam &middot; multi-view &middot; segmentation &middot; robotics</sub> | <ol><li>GEAR jointly models geometry and motion as interdependent components within a Gaussian Splatting representation.</li><li>Uses a vanilla 2D segmentation model to provide multi-view part priors and employs a weakly supervised constraint to regularize the latent variable.</li></ol> |
| [PanopticQuery: Unified Query-Time Reasoning for 4D Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.05638) (2026)<br><br><sub>tracking-slam &middot; multi-view &middot; native-4dgs &middot; segmentation</sub> | <ol><li>Enables unified query-time reasoning in 4D scenes.</li><li>Builds on 4D Gaussian Splatting for dynamic reconstruction and introduces a multi-view semantic consensus mechanism that grounds natural language queries by aggregating 2D semantic predictions across multiple views and time frames.</li></ol> |
| [Director: Instance-aware Gaussian Splatting for Dynamic Scene Modeling and Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.01678) (2026)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://caiyw2023.github.io/Director/ "Project page")<br><sub>tracking-slam &middot; multi-view &middot; per-scene &middot; tracking &middot; segmentation &middot; human</sub> | <ol><li>Learns instance-consistent and language-aligned Gaussian features from temporally aligned masks and multimodal-language-model sentence embeddings.</li><li>Uses optical flow to bridge 2D and 4D motion, improving dynamic Gaussian initialization and reducing temporal drift.</li><li>Adds geometry-aware SDF and surface-continuity constraints for coherent reconstruction, instance segmentation, and open-vocabulary querying.</li></ol> |
| [MotionScale: Reconstructing Appearance, Geometry, and Motion of Dynamic Scenes with Scalable 4D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.29296) (2026)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://hrzhou2.github.io/motion-scale-web/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/hrzhou2/motion-scale "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>monocular-reconstruction &middot; monocular &middot; per-scene &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; tracking</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces a scalable motion field based on cluster-centric basis transformations that expand to model evolving motion patterns.</li><li>Uses progressive background extension to incorporate newly visible regions, refine camera poses, and model transient shadows.</li><li>Adds foreground propagation with staged refinement to enforce motion consistency over large scenes and extended sequences.</li></ol> |

| [4D Synchronized Fields: Motion-Language Gaussian Splatting for Temporal Scene Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.14301) (2026)<br><br><sub>tracking-slam &middot; segmentation &middot; native-4dgs &middot; driving &middot; physics-aware</sub><br><sub>⚠ unverified: method</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces 4D Synchronized Fields, a 4D Gaussian representation that learns object-factored motion in-loop during reconstruction and synchronizes language to the resulting kinematics through a per-object conditioned field.</li><li>Each Gaussian trajectory is decomposed into shared object motion plus an implicit residual, and a kinematic-conditioned ridge map predicts temporal semantic variation.</li><li>On HyperNeRF, 4D Synchronized Fields achieves 28.52 dB mean PSNR, the highest among all language-grounded and motion-aware baselines, within 1.5 dB of reconstruction-only methods.</li></ol> |

| [NRGS-SLAM: Monocular Non-Rigid SLAM for Endoscopy via Deformation-Aware 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.17182) (2026)<br><br><sub>tracking-slam &middot; slam &middot; endoscopy-surgery &middot; monocular &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; online</sub><br><sub>⚠ unverified: experiments, method</sub> | <ol><li>A deformation-aware 3D Gaussian map: each canonical Gaussian carries a learnable deformation probability that soft-gates its temporal offset and rasterizes into a dense deformation confidence map (3D_Gaussian_map.tex:10-55).</li><li>Bayesian self-supervision for that probability without non-rigidity labels: each windowed keyframe is rendered under a forced-rigid and a forced-deformable hypothesis, and the residual difference is fused as log-odds into a pseudo-ground-truth posterior (Deformable_Mapping.tex:101-191).</li><li>Deformable tracking that spends the probability map on decoupling ego-motion from deformation: rigidity-weighted PnP, then dense refinement weighted by rendered rigidity, then a gated residual-only deformation update (Deformable_Tracking.tex:112-221).</li></ol> |

| [Consistent Instance Field for Dynamic Scene Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.14126) (2025)<br><br><sub>tracking-slam &middot; segmentation &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; monocular &middot; multi-view &middot; per-scene</sub> | <ol><li>Consistent Instance Field: each space-time point carries an occupancy probability and a conditional instance distribution, realized as instance-embedded deformable 3D Gaussians rendered by field-aware splatting.</li><li>Instance Identity Estimation calibrates per-Gaussian identities from 2D instance masks probabilistically; Instance-Guided Resampling moves Gaussians toward semantically active regions.</li><li>Reported +11.4 mIoU on HyperNeRF and +5.8 on Neu3D over re-implemented baselines for novel-view panoptic segmentation, plus open-vocabulary 4D querying.</li></ol> |

| [MoSca: Dynamic Gaussian Fusion from Casual Videos via 4D Motion Scaffolds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.17421) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://jiahuilei.com/projects/mosca/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/JiahuiLei/MoSca "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>monocular-reconstruction &middot; monocular &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; tracking &middot; unposed &middot; depth-prior</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces 4D Motion Scaffolds, a compact and smooth representation of motion and deformation for casual monocular video.</li><li>Disentangles geometry and appearance from deformation by globally fusing Gaussians anchored to the motion scaffold.</li><li>Solves focal length and camera poses through bundle adjustment without external pose-estimation tools.</li></ol> |
| [HUGS: Holistic Urban 3D Scene Understanding via Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.12722) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://xdimlab.github.io/hugs_website "Project page")<br><sub>tracking-slam &middot; driving &middot; segmentation &middot; tracking &middot; per-scene &middot; real-time</sub> | <ol><li>HUGS extends Gaussian Splatting with semantic logits, optical flow, camera exposure and per-vehicle dynamic Gaussians for holistic urban scene understanding (sec_1_intro.tex:17; sec_3_method.tex:6-14).</li><li>A learnable unicycle motion model regularises noisy monocular 3D tracks so static and dynamic objects decompose without ground-truth boxes (sec_1_intro.tex:18; sec_3_method.tex:16-28).</li><li>Best on every metric for KITTI/vKITTI dynamic NVS, the KITTI-360 appearance leaderboard and 3D semantic reconstruction; semantic leaderboard comparable to PNF (mIoU_cat 85.64 vs 84.97, mIoU_cls 72.65 vs 73.06) (tab:dynamic_noisy; tab:leaderboard_kitti360; tab:semantic_3d; sec_4_experiment.tex:109).</li></ol> |
| [DeformGS: Scene Flow in Highly Deformable Scenes for Deformable Object Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.00583) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://deformgs.github.io "Project page")<br><sub>tracking-slam &middot; multi-view &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; tracking &middot; robotics &middot; physics-aware</sub><br><sub>⚠ unverified: experiments</sub> | <ol><li>Canonical 3D Gaussians warped by a HexPlane-encoded MLP emitting position, rotation and a sigmoid-bounded shadow scalar on RGB, but deliberately not opacity or scale, so Gaussians move with the material rather than fading.</li><li>Physics-inspired regularizers over three adjacent timesteps: an isometry loss adopted from Dynamic 3D Gaussians and a conservation-of-momentum term, applied only to Gaussians a learned mask, fitted to SAM and XMem masks, marks dynamic.</li><li>Six Blender cloth scenes with ground-truth mesh-vertex trajectories, on which DeformGS cuts mean 3D median trajectory error from 4D-GS's 62.778 mm to 27.754 mm and reaches 3.373 mm on Scene 1.</li></ol> |
| [DynMF: Neural Motion Factorization for Real-time Dynamic View Synthesis with 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.00112) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://agelosk.github.io/dynmf/ "Project page")<br><sub>multi-view-reconstruction &middot; per-scene &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; fast-training &middot; real-time &middot; tracking</sub> | <ol><li>Factorizes Gaussian motion into a small set of global basis trajectories and per-Gaussian combination coefficients.</li><li>Uses sparsity to disentangle independently moving regions without requiring object-level supervision.</li><li>Provides efficient training and real-time rendering while exposing trajectories useful for point tracking.</li></ol> |
| [Dynamic Gaussian Splatting from Markerless Motion Capture can Reconstruct Infants Movements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.19441) (2023)<br><br><sub>tracking-slam &middot; tracking &middot; segmentation</sub> | <ol><li>Leverages semantic segmentation masks to focus on the infant, improving the initialization of the scene.</li><li>Uses the reconstructed dynamic Gaussians for novel-view rendering and infant-motion tracking.</li></ol> |
| [Dynamic 3D Gaussians: Tracking by Persistent Dynamic View Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.09713) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://dynamic3dgaussians.github.io/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/JonathonLuiten/Dynamic3DGaussians "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>tracking-slam &middot; multi-view &middot; per-scene &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; tracking &middot; editing</sub> | <ol><li>Jointly performs dynamic novel-view synthesis and dense 6-DoF tracking of scene elements.</li><li>Allows Gaussians to move and rotate while enforcing persistent color, opacity, and size over time.</li><li>Regularizes motion and rotation with local-rigidity constraints.</li></ol> |

</details>
<!-- paper-category:end -->

## Dynamic humans and avatars

This section includes dynamic-human reconstruction and animatable Gaussian avatars. These works
may use articulated or mesh-anchored 3D Gaussians instead of a native 4D Gaussian primitive, but
they represent appearance over time and are part of the wider 4DGS ecosystem.

| Paper (arXiv) | Key contributions |
| --- | --- |
| [SACHA: Semantic-Aware Compression for 3D Gaussian Head Avatars](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23133) (2026)<br><br><sub>efficiency &middot; compression &middot; human &middot; multi-view &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; per-scene</sub> | <ol><li>Decomposes a dynamic Gaussian head avatar into a canonical Gaussian asset coded once with its FLAME binding indices and per-frame FLAME parameters, split into static and dynamic components and CABAC-coded, that carry all motion.</li><li>Adds semantic-aware density control: a region-wise modulator, the ratio of global to region-level learned perceptual sensitivity, rescales the densification threshold and pruning ratio of each of eight FLAME mask regions within fixed bounds.</li><li>Introduces a perceptual importance score extending LightGaussian's measure with a pixel-level reference sensitivity map and a learned per-Gaussian sensitivity, used to rank primitives for removal independently inside each semantic region.</li></ol> |
| [4DAnyone: Create Anyone in 4D from a Casual Monocular Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.20335) (2026)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://4danyone.github.io "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/ant-research/4DAnyone "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>generation &middot; monocular &middot; unposed &middot; human &middot; synthetic</sub><br><sub>⚠ unverified: method</sub> | <ol><li>Reference Context Packing compresses an unbounded set of previously generated reference views into fixed-length mixed-resolution DiT token slots, holding reference-context cost at O(1) as the view count grows.</li><li>Target Context Routing rotates target-view groupings across denoising steps at high noise and fixes adjacent groups at low noise, reducing cross-group structural drift under a fixed per-group memory budget.</li><li>Depth-buffered 3D skeleton conditioning replaces dense metric depth, and an off-the-shelf FreeTimeGS stage lifts the 16 generated view videos into the final 4D Gaussian human reconstruction.</li></ol> |
| [AvatarDynamizer: From Static to Dynamic Human Avatars via Generative Dynamic Textures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.19900) (2026)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://vcai.mpi-inf.mpg.de/projects/AvatarDynamizer/ "Project page")<br><sub>generation &middot; human &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; multi-view &middot; large-model</sub><br><sub>⚠ unverified: experiments, method</sub> | <ol><li>A texture-space surface-dynamics embedding storing a 4D human as compact 2D dynamic texture maps, decoded by a Generalized Gaussian Decoder into texel-aligned 3D Gaussians for multi-view-consistent rendering (sec/3_method.tex:66-69).</li><li>A Dynamic Texture Generator casting avatar dynamics as identity- and motion-conditioned video generation in texel space, so a pre-trained video diffusion prior synthesizes pose-dependent wrinkle textures (sec/3_method.tex:82-90).</li><li>DynaHuman, a multi-view dataset of 58 subjects, each 27,000 frames from 100 synchronized 4K cameras, with SMPL-X tracking, NeuS2 geometry and registered textures (sec/7_supp.tex:42-50).</li></ol> |
| [Scanline-Aware Animatable Gaussian Avatars from Rolling-Shutter Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.17314) (2026)<br><br><sub>avatar &middot; human &middot; multi-view &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; continuous-time &middot; per-scene</sub> | <ol><li>Places the rolling shutter inside an animatable Gaussian avatar's image formation model: the T sub-frame renderings a blur model averages are instead composited per scanline band, the only change to the pipeline.</li><li>That transferring a motion-aware blur model to rolling-shutter input scores 22.99 dB PSNR on RS-ZJU, below the 23.69 dB shutter-oblivious GauHuman baseline, while the scanline operator reaches 24.68 dB.</li><li>Introduces RS-ZJU, a rolling-shutter avatar benchmark built from six refined ZJU-MoCap subjects by RIFE temporal upsampling and per-row compositing, keeping the original sharp frames as novel-view ground truth.</li></ol> |
| [PD-GS: Phoneme-Driven 3DGS for Audio-Driven Talking Heads](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05218) (2026)<br><br><sub>avatar &middot; monocular &middot; human &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; per-scene &middot; real-time</sub><br><sub>⚠ unverified: experiments</sub> | <ol><li>A dual-stream 3DGS talking-head framework: a shared HuBERT encoder feeds an expression stream predicting blendshape weights and an articulation stream that also receives time-aligned phoneme tokens; their summed deformations animate a canonical Gaussian avatar.</li><li>The Linguistic Fusion Module: a learned channel-wise gate in [0,1]^D, predicted jointly from the audio context and the phoneme embedding, interpolating per channel between them with no external confidence signal and no phoneme-classification loss.</li><li>On the 17-row HDTF table PD-GS reports the minimum LMD (2.66), LPIPS (0.027) and NIQE (3.61), the runner-up PSNR (33.55) and model size (24 MB), and Sync 8.85, third behind 9.13 and 8.89.</li></ol> |
| [Multi-View Face and Gesture Animation with Dynamic Gaussians](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.04722) (2026)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://dfki-av.github.io/MVFGA/ "Project page")<br><sub>avatar &middot; multi-view &middot; human &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; per-scene &middot; real-time</sub><br><sub>⚠ unverified: experiments</sub> | <ol><li>An upper-body parametric model: SMPL-X topology restricted to the upper body, with FLAME expression and MANO hand parameters injected into it (EGauthorGuidelines-body_with_teaser.inc:268-274).</li><li>One 3D Gaussian per mesh triangle, held in the triangle local frame and transformed by its parent triangle as the mesh is posed, giving a deformable avatar (EGauthorGuidelines-body_with_teaser.inc:365-377).</li><li>MVFGA-MoCap, a multi-view upper-body motion-capture dataset: calibrated synchronized cameras, 1920x1080 at 25 FPS, expressions and gestures (sec/X_suppl.tex:21-26, 166-169).</li></ol> |
| [Forwardrobe: Garment-Aware Gaussian Avatars from a Single Image](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.29106) (2026)<br><br><sub>avatar &middot; feed-forward &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; human &middot; editing</sub> | <ol><li>First feed-forward framework to extract the garment observed in a single clothed-person image as an independent, motion-conditioned 3D Gaussian asset and recompose it onto another avatar without per-garment optimization.</li><li>A garment-aware representation pairing VLM-guided continuity-aware geometry and skinning initialization with pose-conditioned deformation and appearance residuals, improving continuity for skirt-like garments under large articulated motion.</li><li>The separated garment layer enables garment recoloring, cross-avatar transfer, and 3D virtual try-on within a shared canonical template, without garment-specific retraining.</li></ol> |
| [S-Avatar: Diffusion-Guided Gaussian Head Avatars from a Single Image](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28164) (2026)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/hailsong/savatar "Project page")<br><sub>avatar &middot; monocular &middot; human &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; real-time</sub> | <ol><li>S-Avatar builds an animatable 3D head avatar from one RGB image in three phases: diffusion-based Gaussian splat generation, FLAME fitting to those splats, and a binding template that deforms them (sections/3_Method.tex:6-12).</li><li>The binding template holds inverse-distance weights from each splat to its N_closest FLAME vertices, so splats follow vertex displacements as Delta_S = B^T (V' - V) without re-optimization (sections/3_Method.tex:215-236, 251-261).</li><li>On NeRSemble the reported table gives S-Avatar LPIPS 0.258, PSNR 16.10 and SSIM 0.826, each the best value in its column, at 0.028 s per rendered frame (sections/4_Experiments.tex:76-91, 153-172).</li></ol> |
| [4DHumanDiff: Direct Text-to-4DGS Generation for Consistent 360-Degree Dynamic Humans](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27634) (2026)<br><br><sub>generation &middot; human &middot; native-4dgs &middot; large-model</sub> | <ol><li>Generates text-conditioned dynamic humans directly in 4D Gaussian space instead of fitting a representation to generated videos.</li><li>Combines a 3D U-Net with temporal attention, 2D regularization, and training-free 4D interpolation for view and motion consistency.</li><li>Constructs 60,000 text-to-4DGS training pairs and produces 360-degree dynamic humans within one minute.</li></ol> |
| [Head Avatars with Dynamic Explicit Hair](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23861) (2026)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://dynhair.is.tue.mpg.de/ "Project page") [![Non-functional or unverified GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-8c959f?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Vanessik/DynHair "Placeholder or documentation-only GitHub repository")<br><sub>avatar &middot; multi-view &middot; human &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; physics-aware &middot; tracking</sub> | <ol><li>Builds a hybrid head avatar with explicit Gaussian hair strands and unstructured Gaussians for the face and upper body.</li><li>Models hair inertia with an LSTM conditioned on head angular velocity, acceleration, and relative gravity, followed by FiLM-modulated strand deformation.</li><li>Jointly optimizes appearance and motion using photometric, geometric, and physics-based supervision from synchronized multi-view video.</li></ol> |
| [URHead: A Unified UV-Space Representation for Joint Mesh-3DGS Optimization in Head Avatars](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22673) (2026)<br><br>[![Non-functional or unverified GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-8c959f?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Lseonghak/URHead "GitHub repository status not verified")<br><sub>avatar &middot; monocular &middot; per-scene &middot; hybrid &middot; human &middot; real-time</sub><br><sub>⚠ unverified: experiments</sub> | <ol><li>Mesh and 3D Gaussians are expressed as dense maps over one shared FLAME UV domain, with colour, normal and displacement maps read by both renderers (sec/3_proposed.tex:32-40).</li><li>Sharing those maps makes the photometric loss flow into them through both rendering paths, so the Gaussian branch refines mesh geometry through the shared normal map (sec/3_proposed.tex:83-89).</li><li>New Gaussians are allocated from photometric error accumulated in UV space, replacing the gradient-based densification 3DGS performs in unstructured 3D space (sec/3_proposed.tex:119-134).</li></ol> |

| [GAF: Gaussian Avatar Reconstruction from Monocular Videos via Multi-view Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.10209) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://tangjiapeng.github.io/projects/GAF "Project page")<br><sub>avatar &middot; monocular &middot; human &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; generation &middot; large-model</sub><br><sub>⚠ unverified: method</sub> | <ol><li>GAF reconstructs animatable FLAME-rigged Gaussian head avatars from front-facing monocular videos by regularising unobserved regions with a multi-view head diffusion prior.</li><li>A normal-map-guided multi-view head diffusion model (from Stable Diffusion 2.1 / ImageDream, trained on NeRSemble) that generates view-consistent views of a head from one image with VAE identity conditioning.</li><li>Iteratively denoised, latent-upsampled images serve as pseudo ground truths instead of SDS, avoiding over-saturation; best LPIPS/SSIM on NeRSemble monocular novel-view and novel-expression synthesis.</li></ol> |
