| [AniGS: Animatable Gaussian Avatar from a Single Image with Inconsistent Gaussian Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.02684) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://lingtengqiu.github.io/2024/AniGS/ "Project page")<br><sub>avatar &middot; human &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; generation &middot; real-time</sub><br><sub>⚠ unverified: method</sub> | <ol><li>Adapts a transformer video-diffusion model (CogVideo DiT) to generate multi-view canonical-pose RGB images and normal maps from one human image, pretrained on in-the-wild human videos.</li><li>Recasts reconstruction from view-inconsistent generated images as 4D reconstruction: a canonical 3DGS plus a HexPlane/MLP deformation field indexed by view, read out at t=0.</li><li>Initializes the 4DGS from an SMPL-X mesh deformed to the generated masks and normals, and animates the canonical avatar with diffused SMPL-X skinning weights.</li></ol> |
| [SAGA: Surface-Aligned Gaussian Avatar](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.00845) (2024)<br><br><sub>avatar &middot; monocular &middot; human &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; fast-training</sub><br><sub>⚠ unverified: method</sub> | <ol><li>Two-stage surface-aligned Gaussian avatar from monocular video: Gaussians are first adhered to an SMPL mesh (free to flow on it) and then detached, with LBS warping plus a hash-encoded non-rigid deformation MLP.</li><li>Gaussian-Mesh Alignment regularization (position and normal alignment losses to bound triangles) and a Walking-on-Mesh update of bound triangles as Gaussians drift.</li><li>SSIM/LPIPS on ZJU-MoCap, MonoCap and PeopleSnapshot novel-view synthesis with 12-minute training and 60 FPS at 512x512 on an RTX 3090; direct mesh extraction from monocular deformable Gaussians.</li></ol> |
| [GaussianSpeech: Audio-Driven Gaussian Avatars](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.18675) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://shivangi-aneja.github.io/projects/gaussianspeech "Project page")<br><sub>avatar &middot; multi-view &middot; human &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; per-scene &middot; dataset</sub><br><sub>⚠ unverified: method</sub> | <ol><li>First transformer-based sequence model that animates a lightweight FLAME-bound 3D Gaussian head avatar directly from audio, predicting expressions and per-vertex offsets with lip and wrinkle features from Wav2Vec 2.0.</li><li>A personalized avatar initialization extending GaussianAvatars with mouth-region subdivision, volume-based pruning, perceptual loss and wrinkle regularization, converging to roughly 30-35K Gaussians.</li><li>A new 16-view audio-video dataset of six native English speakers, about 2500 sequences and 3.5 hours at 3208x2200 and 30 FPS.</li></ol> |
| [Sequential Gaussian Avatars with Hierarchical Motion Context](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.16768) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://zezeaaa.github.io/projects/SeqAvatar/ "Project page")<br><sub>avatar &middot; human &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; real-time &middot; driving</sub><br><sub>⚠ unverified: method</sub> | <ol><li>Models avatar deformation with hierarchical motion context over skeleton and vertex motion.</li><li>Combines coarse skeleton motion with fine-grained vertex motion for non-rigid deformation.</li><li>Renders avatars orders of magnitude faster than temporal NeRF baselines.</li></ol> |
| [Motion-Aware Animatable Gaussian Avatars Deblurring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.16758) (2024)<br><br><sub>avatar &middot; multi-view &middot; human &middot; deblurring &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; per-scene</sub><br><sub>⚠ unverified: method</sub> | <ol><li>First model reconstructing sharp, animatable 3D Gaussian human avatars directly from blurry multi-view video via a 3D-aware blur model: a blurry frame is the mean of T renders at sub-frame poses.</li><li>A 3D human motion model for sub-frame pose: B-spline interpolation over P learnable control knots per SMPL joint, a CNN pose displacement term, and an inter-frame geodesic regularizer that resolves motion-direction ambiguity.</li><li>A synthetic blur benchmark built on ZJU-MoCap and a real twelve-camera hybrid-exposure capture with blurry training views and sharp novel-view test views.</li></ol> |
| [FATE: Full-head Gaussian Avatar with Textural Editing from Monocular Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.15604) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://zjwfufu.github.io/FATE-page/ "Project page")<br><sub>avatar &middot; monocular &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; editing &middot; human</sub><br><sub>⚠ unverified: method</sub> | <ol><li>Monocular head-avatar reconstruction with Gaussians sampled uniformly in FLAME UV space plus normal offsets, driven by learnable expression/pose blendshapes, with sampling-based densification instead of gradient-based cloning.</li><li>Neural baking: a two-stage U-Net (BakeNet) converts the trained discrete Gaussians into continuous UV attribute maps so appearance can be edited like mesh textures.</li><li>A universal completion framework that inverts a pre-trained SphereHead generator (PTI) to synthesise pseudo side/rear views, giving a 360-degree renderable avatar from a frontal monocular video.</li></ol> |
| [GGAvatar: Reconstructing Garment-Separated 3D Gaussian Splatting Avatars from Monocular Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.09952) (2024)<br><br>[![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/J-X-Chen/GGAvatar/ "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>avatar &middot; monocular &middot; per-scene &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; human &middot; editing</sub><br><sub>⚠ unverified: method</sub> | <ol><li>Reconstructs clothed-human avatars from monocular video as separate Gaussian sets for body and each garment, all skinned by shared SMPL bones through LBS with learnable skinning weights.</li><li>Initializes garment Gaussians from parametric garment meshes estimated by ISP from FrankMocap pose and SCHP segmentation of a front view.</li><li>Uses phased training: per-part isolation training with densify-and-prune, then joint training with S3IM, as-isometric-as-possible, similarity and collision losses.</li></ol> |
| [URAvatar: Universal Relightable Gaussian Codec Avatars](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.24223) (2024)<br><br><sub>avatar &middot; human &middot; relighting &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; multi-view &middot; real-time</sub><br><sub>⚠ unverified: experiments, method</sub> | <ol><li>A universal relightable Gaussian avatar prior learned from hundreds of multi-view, multi-light dynamic performance captures, with identity-conditioned hypernetwork, expression encoder and learnable radiance transfer (main.tex:362-364, 489-557).</li><li>Personalised drivable and relightable head avatars from a single phone scan under unknown illumination, by fitting environment lighting and fine-tuning the pretrained encoders and decoders (main.tex:365, 642-675).</li><li>An LED-wall capture system and evaluation protocol measuring relighting accuracy under continuous illuminations against ground truth (main.tex:366, 700-719).</li></ol> |
| [SurFhead: Affine Rig Blending for Geometrically Accurate 2D Gaussian Surfel Head Avatars](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.11682) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://summertight.github.io/SurFhead/ "Project page") [![Non-functional or unverified GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-8c959f?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/SurFhead2025/SurFhead.git "Placeholder or documentation-only GitHub repository")<br><sub>avatar &middot; human &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; multi-view &middot; per-scene &middot; explicit</sub><br><sub>⚠ unverified: method</sub> | <ol><li>Rigs 2D Gaussian surfels to FLAME triangles with the affine Jacobian deformation gradient J instead of a similarity transform, and deforms normals with J^-T for stretch- and shear-aware geometry.</li><li>Jacobian Blend Skinning: blends adjacent triangles' Jacobians via polar decomposition into rotation and stretch parts, avoiding LBS distortion and discontinuities at extreme poses.</li><li>The best normal cosine similarity on FaceTalk and NeRSemble against IMAvatar, FLARE, PointAvatar, SplattingAvatar and GaussianAvatars while matching their image quality.</li></ol> |
| [Learning Interaction-aware 3D Gaussian Splatting for One-shot Hand Avatars](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.08840) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/XuanHuang0/GuassianHand "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/XuanHuang0/GuassianHand "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>avatar &middot; human &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; sparse-view &middot; explicit</sub> | <ol><li>Two-stage interaction-aware Gaussian Splatting framework that builds animatable interacting-hand avatars from a single image using cross-subject hand priors.</li><li>Disentangles hands into learned latent geometric features and neural texture maps plus per-subject optimisable identity maps for fast one-shot fitting.</li><li>Interaction-aware attention and a self-adaptive Gaussian refinement module that prunes, splits and offsets MANO-initialised Gaussians in interacting regions.</li></ol> |
| [Generalizable and Animatable Gaussian Head Avatar](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.07971) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://xg-chu.site/project_gagavatar/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/xg-chu/GAGAvatar "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>avatar &middot; monocular &middot; feed-forward &middot; human &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; real-time</sub> | <ol><li>Reconstructs an animatable head avatar from one image by predicting 3D Gaussian parameters in one forward pass.</li><li>Introduces dual lifting to create identity- and facial-detail-preserving Gaussians from image and 3D morphable-model features.</li><li>Supports unseen identities without per-subject optimization and real-time expression reenactment.</li></ol> |
| [TextToon: Real-Time Text Toonify Head Avatar from Single Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.07160) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://songluchuan.github.io/TextToon/ "Project page")<br><sub>avatar &middot; monocular &middot; human &middot; real-time &middot; per-scene</sub> | <ol><li>Text-driven toonification of a head avatar from a single monocular video, combining 3D Gaussian Splatting with an InstructPix2Pix text-to-image editor.</li><li>A conditional Tri-plane Gaussian deformation field decodes per-frame Gaussian position, rotation, scale, SH and opacity from expression coefficients and orthographic renderings.</li><li>A real-time system: about 48 FPS pure inference and about 25 FPS end-to-end on an RTX 4090, 15-18 FPS on an Apple M1 MacBook.</li></ol> |
| [DreamWaltz-G: Expressive 3D Gaussian Avatars from Skeleton-Guided 2D Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.17145) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://yukun-huang.github.io/DreamWaltz-G/ "Project page")<br><sub>generation &middot; human &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; hybrid &middot; per-scene</sub> | <ol><li>DreamWaltz-G: a text-driven framework producing animatable 3D Gaussian avatars ready for expressive animation, extending the NeRF-based DreamWaltz conference version (sections/1.introduction.tex:31-41).</li><li>SkelSD: skeleton-guided score distillation that conditions the 2D diffusion model on SMPL-X skeleton renderings with occlusion culling to reduce view and pose inconsistency (sections/1.introduction.tex:34, sections/3.method.tex:63-85).</li><li>H3GA: hybrid 3D Gaussian avatar of unconstrained and mesh-bound Gaussians with NeRF-predicted colour and opacity, LBS articulation with KNN-smoothed weights, and a pose-conditioned deformation MLP (sections/3.method.tex:86-134, 172-183).</li></ol> |
| [Portrait Video Editing Empowered by Multimodal Generative Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.13591) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://ustc3dv.github.io/PortraitGen/ "Project page")<br><sub>generation &middot; editing &middot; human &middot; monocular &middot; mesh-anchored</sub> | <ol><li>PortraitGen lifts portrait video editing into 3D: frames are fitted to a dynamic 3D Gaussian field embedded on SMPL-X, giving 3D and temporal consistency of edits (Sec01_Introduction.tex:25).</li><li>Neural Gaussian Texture: Gaussians on the SMPL-X UV space store learnable features instead of SH, splatted to a feature image and decoded by a 2D neural renderer (Sec01_Introduction.tex:26, Sec03_Method.tex:52-70).</li><li>Expression similarity guidance and face-aware portrait editing to counter degradation under iterative dataset update from 2D generative priors (Sec01_Introduction.tex:27, Sec03_Method.tex:143-155).</li></ol> |
| [GaussianHeads: End-to-End Learning of Drivable Gaussian Head Avatars from Coarse-to-fine Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.11951) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://vcai.mpi-inf.mpg.de/projects/GaussianHeads/ "Project page")<br><sub>avatar &middot; human &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; multi-view &middot; real-time &middot; deformable-3dgs</sub> | <ol><li>Real-time drivable head avatars from multi-view RGB video using 3D Gaussians, handling large deformations such as mouth interior, tongue and teeth under strong head motion.</li><li>A coarse-to-fine representation: an expression-code-driven deformable FLAME-topology mesh on which Gaussians are initialized and then refined by expression-conditioned offset, opacity and color decoders.</li><li>End-to-end training that jointly supervises head pose, geometry and appearance, reaching ~75 FPS rendering and outperforming MVP, HQ3DAvatar and GaussianAvatars.</li></ol> |
| [Robust Dual Gaussian Splatting for Immersive Human-centric Volumetric Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.08353) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://nowheretrix.github.io/DualGS/ "Project page")<br><sub>efficiency &middot; human &middot; real-time &middot; compression &middot; tracking &middot; generation</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces a Gaussian-based approach, dubbed DualGS, for real-time and playback of complex human performance with excellent compression ratios.</li><li>Employs a coarse-to-fine training strategy for frame-by-frame human performance modeling.</li><li>Achieves a compression ratio of up to 120 times, only requiring approximately 350KB of storage per frame.</li></ol> |
| [DEGAS: Detailed Expressions on Full-Body Gaussian Avatars](https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.10588) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://initialneil.github.io/DEGAS "Project page")<br><sub>avatar &middot; human &middot; multi-view &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; real-time</sub> | <ol><li>First 3DGS-based full-body talking avatar: a conditional VAE decodes SMPL-X body pose plus a face latent into Gaussian maps in the SMPL-X UV layout, posed by LBS (sec/2_method.tex:82-145).</li><li>Facial expressions driven by the pretrained 2D expression encoder of DPE instead of a 3DMM, bridging 2D talking faces and 3D avatars (sec/2_method.tex:52-80).</li><li>DREAMS-Avatar, a multi-view dataset of 6 subjects captured with 32 12MP cameras performing large poses and rich expressions, released for research (sec/3_experiment.tex:64-68, sec/X_suppl.tex:56-58).</li></ol> |
| **[New]** [3D-Consistent Human Avatars with Sparse Inputs via Gaussian Splatting and Contrastive Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.09663) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://chaseprojectpage.github.io/ "Project page")<br><sub>avatar &middot; human &middot; monocular &middot; sparse-frame &middot; deformable-3dgs</sub><br><sub>⚠ unverified: experiments</sub> | <ol><li>Dynamic Avatar Adjustment: for each training pose a similar pose is chosen by SMPL orientation and limb-angle difference, and deformed Gaussians are re-posed by F_adj = F_o-prime F_o^-1 for extra supervision (main.tex:274-300).</li><li>3D geometry contrastive learning: DGCNN features of adjusted, similar-pose and original Gaussians trained with the hinge loss max(0, D_pos - D_neg) (main.tex:300-315).</li><li>Reported gains over NeRF and 3DGS avatars on ZJU-MoCap and H36M under full inputs and a 5%-frame sparse setting, at 50 FPS (main.tex:379-412, 437-460).</li></ol> |
| [HeadGAP: Few-Shot 3D Head Avatar via Generalizable Gaussian Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.06019) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://headgap.github.io/ "Project page")<br><sub>avatar &middot; human &middot; sparse-view &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; multi-view</sub> | <ol><li>A prior-learning / avatar-creation framework: a Gaussian-Splatting auto-decoder trained on 119 NeRSemble identities, then personalized to a identity from one to three images by latent inversion plus fine-tuning (sec/1_intro.tex:31).</li><li>Part-based dynamic Gaussian modeling: 11 FLAME-mask parts, each with a part-specific MLP regressing Gaussian attributes from identity-shared point encodings, per-part identity codes, and point-specific expression displacement signals (sec/3_method.tex:81).</li><li>A same-resolution screen-space CNN refining the splatted RGB plus latent feature image, with quantitative ablations on NeRSemble and in-the-wild iPad captures (sec/3_method.tex:108, sec/4_experiment.tex:120-140).</li></ol> |
| [EmoTalk3D: High-Fidelity Free-View Synthesis of Emotional 3D Talking Head](https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.00297) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://nju-3dv.github.io/projects/EmoTalk3D "Project page")<br><sub>avatar &middot; human &middot; multi-view &middot; dataset-release &middot; generation &middot; per-scene</sub><br><sub>⚠ unverified: method</sub> | <ol><li>EmoTalk3D dataset: 30 subjects, 11 synchronized calibrated cameras, 20 sentences under 8 emotions with two intensities, with per-frame reconstructed 3D face geometry and emotion annotations.</li><li>A Speech-to-Geometry-to-Appearance framework: S2GNet predicts 4D facial points from audio, and G2ANet turns them into per-frame 3D Gaussians.</li><li>Appearance disentangled into canonical Gaussians from a neutral frame and dynamic features and rotations predicted by FeatureNet and RotationNet, fused for free-view emotional talking-head rendering.</li></ol> |
| [Expressive Whole-Body 3D Gaussian Avatar](https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.21686) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://mks0601.github.io/ExAvatar/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/mks0601/ExAvatar_RELEASE "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>avatar &middot; monocular &middot; human &middot; hybrid &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; per-scene</sub> | <ol><li>Builds a whole-body avatar from a short monocular video by combining SMPL-X mesh topology with 3D Gaussians.</li><li>Associates Gaussians with mesh connectivity so SMPL-X expression parameters drive facial expressions.</li><li>Uses connectivity-based regularizers to reduce artifacts under expressions and poses.</li></ol> |
| [Surfel-based Gaussian Inverse Rendering for Fast and Relightable Dynamic Human Reconstruction from Monocular Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.15212) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://GS-IA.github.io "Project page")<br><sub>avatar &middot; human &middot; monocular &middot; relighting &middot; surface-gaussian &middot; fast-training</sub> | <ol><li>SGIA: a clothed human avatar as PBR-aware 2D Gaussian surfels in canonical space, articulated by SMPL linear blend skinning, carrying albedo, roughness and metallic per surfel.</li><li>Physically based rendering with pre-integration and image-based lighting plus an occlusion approximation, giving relighting of reposed avatars far faster than implicit inverse-rendering baselines.</li><li>A two-stage progressive schedule (image reconstruction, then PBR material optimization) that trains in about 40 minutes on one GPU.</li></ol> |

| [MonoGaussianAvatar: Monocular Gaussian Point-based Head Avatar](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.04558) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://yufan1012.github.io/MonoGaussianAvatar "Project page")<br><sub>avatar &middot; monocular &middot; per-scene &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; human</sub><br><sub>⚠ unverified: experiments</sub> | <ol><li>Gaussian point-based explicit head avatar from monocular video: canonical Gaussians are moved by FLAME-style learned blendshapes and skinning weights, and a Gaussian deformation field MLP offsets rotation, scale, opacity and colour.</li><li>A point insertion and deletion strategy grows the Gaussian set from 400 sphere samples to 100K while pruning low-opacity points, with sampling and rendering radius decay across epochs.</li><li>Lower L1, LPIPS and higher SSIM, PSNR than Nerface, IMavatar and PointAvatar on test poses and expressions, with 9 h training and 0.001 s per-image rendering.</li></ol> |
| [Relightable Gaussian Codec Avatars](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.03704) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://shunsukesaito.github.io/rgca/ "Project page")<br><sub>avatar &middot; multi-view &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; real-time &middot; relighting &middot; human</sub> | <ol><li>Drivable head avatars whose 3D Gaussians are decoded per expression from a CVAE latent on a UV template map, capturing hair strands and pores.</li><li>A learnable radiance transfer appearance model: SH-based diffuse with global light transport plus a normalized spherical-Gaussian specular term for all-frequency real-time relighting.</li><li>A relightable explicit eye model with frozen eyeball Gaussians and view-conditioned albedo, giving gaze control and mirror-like eye reflections.</li></ol> |
| [HiFi4G: High-Fidelity Human Performance Rendering via Compact Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.03461) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://nowheretrix.github.io/HiFi4G/ "Project page")<br><sub>efficiency &middot; multi-view &middot; human &middot; compression &middot; tracking &middot; native-4dgs</sub> | <ol><li>Combines Gaussian splatting with non-rigid tracking through a coarse deformation graph and fine Gaussian graph.</li><li>Optimizes a 4D Gaussian representation with adaptive spatial-temporal regularization for dense human-performance footage.</li><li>Introduces residual-compensated compression for compact playback-oriented representations.</li></ol> |
| [HHAvatar: Gaussian Head Avatar with Dynamic Hairs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.03029) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://liaozhanfeng.github.io/HHAvatar "Project page")<br><sub>avatar &middot; multi-view &middot; sparse-view &middot; per-scene &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; human</sub> | <ol><li>Head avatar from sparse multi-view video: neutral 3D Gaussians plus fully learned MLP deformation, colour and attribute fields conditioned on expression coefficients and head pose, rendered at 2K with a super-resolution network.</li><li>First head avatar modelling physical hair motion: a separate hair Gaussian set deformed by an MLP that takes the two previous frames' positions and three frames of head pose, with an occlusion perception module.</li><li>Geometry-guided initialization from an implicit SDF and Deep Marching Tetrahedra stabilizes training; reports higher PSNR, SSIM and lower LPIPS, FID than NeRFBlendShape, NeRFace, HAvatar, GaussianAvatars and MeGA.</li></ol> |
| [GauHuman: Articulated Gaussian Splatting from Monocular Human Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.02973) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://skhu101.github.io/GauHuman/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/skhu101/GauHuman "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>avatar &middot; human &middot; monocular &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; fast-training &middot; real-time</sub> | <ol><li>Transforms canonical Gaussians into posed space with linear blend skinning while jointly refining pose and skinning weights.</li><li>Uses human-prior initialization and structure-aware split, clone, merge, and pruning operations for efficient optimization.</li><li>Achieves minute-scale training and high-frame-rate free-viewpoint rendering from a monocular video.</li></ol> |
| [HeadGaS: Real-Time Animatable Head Avatars via 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.02902) (2023)<br><br><sub>avatar &middot; monocular &middot; human &middot; per-scene &middot; hybrid &middot; real-time</sub> | <ol><li>Builds an animatable head avatar by augmenting explicit 3D Gaussian splats with a learned latent feature basis.</li><li>Linearly blends the latent basis with low-dimensional parametric-head controls to produce expression-dependent Gaussian color and opacity.</li><li>Achieves real-time inference while reporting more than a tenfold rendering-speed improvement over prior baselines.</li></ol> |
| [FlashAvatar: High-Fidelity Head Avatar with Efficient Gaussian Embedding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.02214) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://ustc3dv.github.io/FlashAvatar/ "Project page")<br><sub>avatar &middot; monocular &middot; per-scene &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; real-time &middot; human</sub> | <ol><li>Attaches 3D Gaussians to the FLAME mesh surface by uniform UV sampling and learns an expression-conditioned MLP offset on position, rotation and scale to model non-surface regions and facial details.</li><li>Mesh-attached initialization compresses the Gaussian count to about 13K, giving 300 FPS rendering at 512x512 and avatar reconstruction from a short monocular video within minutes.</li><li>Lower MSE, L1 and LPIPS and higher PSNR, SSIM than NHA, PointAvatar and INSTA on data released by prior head-avatar works.</li></ol> |
| [MANUS: Markerless Grasp Capture Using Articulated 3D Gaussians](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.02137) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://ivl.cs.brown.edu/research/manus.html "Project page")<br><sub>avatar &middot; multi-view &middot; per-scene &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; human &middot; dataset</sub> | <ol><li>MANUS-Hand poses canonical 3D Gaussians by linear blend skinning over a 21-bone, 26-DOF skeleton, with skinning weights interpolated from a canonical voxel grid rather than assigned per Gaussian (03_method.tex:136-165).</li><li>Grasp capture concatenates posed hand Gaussians with a static object Gaussian model and reads contact off nearest pairs within a threshold, giving an instantaneous per-frame map and an accumulated map (03_method.tex:213-238).</li><li>MANUS-Grasps, a stated 7M+ frame multi-view grasp dataset from 50+ cameras over 30+ scenes and 3 subjects, with 15 wet-paint sequences giving ground-truth contact (03_method.tex:242-271).</li></ol> |
| [GaussianAvatar: Towards Realistic Human Avatar Modeling from a Single Video via Animatable 3D Gaussians](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.02134) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://huliangxiao.github.io/GaussianAvatar "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/aipixel/GaussianAvatar "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>avatar &middot; monocular &middot; human &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; per-scene &middot; explicit</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces animatable explicit 3D Gaussians for human appearance across poses and clothing styles from a single video.</li><li>Models pose-dependent appearance using a dynamic appearance network and optimizable feature tensor.</li><li>Jointly optimizes motion and appearance through differentiable motion conditioning to address inaccurate monocular motion estimates.</li></ol> |
| [GaussianAvatars: Photorealistic Head Avatars with Rigged 3D Gaussians](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.02069) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://shenhanqian.github.io/gaussian-avatars "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/ShenhanQian/GaussianAvatars "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>avatar &middot; multi-view &middot; human &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; explicit &middot; real-time</sub> | <ol><li>Rigs dynamic 3D Gaussian splats to a parametric morphable face model for controllable pose and expression animation.</li><li>Parameterizes splats in triangle-local coordinate frames with learned displacement offsets.</li><li>Jointly optimizes facial-model and Gaussian parameters for end-to-end avatar reconstruction and reenactment.</li></ol> |
| [GaussianHead: High-Fidelity Head Avatars With Learnable Gaussian Derivation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.01632) (2023)<br><br><sub>avatar &middot; monocular &middot; per-scene &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; human</sub><br><sub>⚠ unverified: experiments</sub> | <ol><li>Models a dynamic head from a monocular video with anisotropic 3D Gaussians whose position, rotation and scale are offset per frame by an expression-conditioned deformation MLP.</li><li>Learnable Gaussian derivation: each core Gaussian is rotated by K learnable unit quaternions into doppelgangers whose single-resolution tri-plane features are concatenated, countering feature dilution.</li><li>Better PSNR, SSIM and LPIPS than six head-avatar baselines on six subjects with an approximately 12 MB model trained about 2 hours on one RTX 3090.</li></ol> |
| [HUGS: Human Gaussian Splats](https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.17910) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://machinelearning.apple.com/research/hugs "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/apple/ml-hugs "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>avatar &middot; monocular &middot; human &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; fast-training &middot; real-time</sub> | <ol><li>Learns a static scene and fully animatable human avatar from a short monocular video using 3D Gaussian splatting.</li><li>Initializes human Gaussians with SMPL and permits deviations for clothing and hair details.</li><li>Jointly optimizes skinning weights to coordinate Gaussian articulation for novel-pose synthesis.</li></ol> |
| [Gaussian Shell Maps for Efficient 3D Human Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.17857) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://rameenabdal.github.io/GaussianShellMaps/ "Project page")<br><sub>generation &middot; human &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; real-time</sub><br><sub>⚠ unverified: experiments</sub> | <ol><li>A 3D GAN whose StyleGAN2 generator emits an N-layer, 11-channel texture stack read by 3D Gaussians anchored at fixed barycentric positions on shells inflated and deflated from an SMPL template.</li><li>Articulation inherited from SMPL: deforming the shells moves and rotates every Gaussian by barycentric and skinning-quaternion interpolation, used during GAN training and to pose generated humans; PCK 99.48 and 99.27 top their columns.</li><li>Native 512x512 adversarial training without an upsampler on single-view images: FID 15.78 on DeepFashion and 13.30 on SHHQ, second lowest in each column, at 28 ms/img, tied with StylePeople for lowest inference time.</li></ol> |
| [Human Gaussian Splatting: Real-time Rendering of Animatable Avatars](https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.17113) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://perezpellitero.github.io/projects/hugs/ "Project page")<br><sub>avatar &middot; multi-view &middot; human &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; real-time &middot; per-scene</sub> | <ol><li>Represents the human body with canonical-space Gaussians learned end-to-end from multi-view observations.</li><li>Deforms the representation with coarse forward skinning followed by local non-rigid refinement.</li><li>Targets real-time novel-pose rendering of clothed-body avatars.</li></ol> |
| [Animatable 3D Gaussian: Fast and High-Quality Reconstruction of Multiple Human Avatars](https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.16482) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://jimmyyliu.github.io/Animatable-3D-Gaussian/ "Project page")<br><sub>avatar &middot; human &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; fast-training &middot; real-time &middot; monocular</sub><br><sub>⚠ unverified: experiments</sub> | <ol><li>Represents a dynamic human as skinned 3D Gaussians on a canonical skeleton, deformed to posed space by linear blend skinning, initialised from a generic skinned model rather than SFM or SMPL shape parameters.</li><li>Samples spherical-harmonic coefficients and a pose-conditioned vertex displacement from hash-encoded parameter fields instead of storing them per Gaussian, which the paper credits for convergence in seconds.</li><li>Adds a time-dependent ambient occlusion factor sampled from a hash field over the Gaussian centre and a frequency-encoded timestamp, so dynamic shadows in multi-person scenes can be fitted.</li></ol> |
| [GART: Gaussian Articulated Template Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.16099) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://jiahuilei.com/projects/gart/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/JiahuiLei/GART "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>avatar &middot; monocular &middot; human &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; fast-training &middot; real-time</sub> | <ol><li>Uses a mixture of moving 3D Gaussians to explicitly model articulated, non-rigid subjects from monocular video.</li><li>Combines a category template such as SMPL or SMAL with learnable forward skinning and latent bones for complex deformation.</li><li>Enables reconstruction in seconds or minutes and fast novel-pose rendering.</li></ol> |
| [Animatable and Relightable Gaussians for High-fidelity Human Avatar Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.16096) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://animatable-gaussians.github.io/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/lizhe00/AnimatableGaussians "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>avatar &middot; multi-view &middot; human &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; relighting &middot; deformable-3dgs</sub> | <ol><li>Parameterizes an animatable template with front and back canonical Gaussian maps.</li><li>Uses an adaptive garment-aware template and pose projection for novel-pose generalization.</li><li>Introduces physically based rendering to decompose material properties and environment illumination for relighting.</li></ol> |
| [SplatArmor: Articulated Gaussian splatting for animatable humans from monocular RGB videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.10812) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://jenaroh.it/splatarmor/ "Project page")<br><sub>avatar &middot; monocular &middot; human &middot; per-scene &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; deformable-3dgs</sub> | <ol><li>Represents a human with canonical 3D Gaussians whose articulation extends SMPL forward skinning to arbitrary canonical-space locations.</li><li>Introduces a pose-dependent SE(3) field that controls both Gaussian positions and anisotropy.</li><li>Uses a neural color field for color regularization and 3D supervision of Gaussian placement.</li></ol> |
| [Drivable 3D Gaussian Avatars](https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.08581) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://wojciechzielonka.com/d3ga/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/facebookresearch/D3GA "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>avatar &middot; multi-view &middot; human &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; explicit &middot; tracking</sub> | <ol><li>Embeds 3D Gaussian primitives in tetrahedral cages, using deformation gradients to transform their orientation and kernels.</li><li>Decouples low-dimensional driving signals from Gaussian primitives through localized cage deformation and learned vertex offsets.</li><li>Composes independently driven avatar layers, such as garments, hands, and face.</li></ol> |

## Adjacent and supporting dynamic-view work

Non-Gaussian dynamic-view methods, static-map dynamic SLAM systems, datasets, surveys, and other
context useful for evaluating or understanding 4DGS. These records are deliberately separated
from methods whose central representation is a time-varying Gaussian field.

<summary>Detailed contributions (50 papers)</summary>

| Paper (arXiv) | Key contributions |
| --- | --- |
| [DL-SLAM: Enabling High-Fidelity Gaussian Splatting SLAM in Dynamic Environments based on Dual-Level Probability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01860) (2026)<br><br><sub>tracking-slam &middot; monocular &middot; slam &middot; tracking &middot; segmentation &middot; generation</sub> | <ol><li>Adjacent work — Dynamic objects are detected and pruned to produce a static Gaussian map; their motion is not represented.</li><li>Introduces DL-SLAM, a monocular Gaussian Splatting SLAM system built upon a dual-level probabilistic framework.</li><li>Computes dynamic probability maps by combining semantic and geometric information.</li></ol> |
| [AvatarMix: Identity-Preserving Cross-Avatar Composition for Outfit Personalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03506) (2026)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://larsph.github.io/avatarmix/ "Project page")<br><sub>generation &middot; multi-view &middot; human &middot; editing</sub> | <ol><li>Adjacent work — Composes and edits static appearance and geometry of Gaussian avatars without temporal or animation-specific processing.</li><li>Introduces AvatarMix, a compositional paradigm that bypasses these issues by directly composing the head and body from two Gaussian avatars.</li><li>Introduces a two-tier refinement strategy: SeamFix, a localized diffusion module that refines hair and neck to ensure an artifact-free join, and an optional full-body refinement, FullbodyFix, that restores garment appearance.</li></ol> |

| **[New]** [EndoGSLAM: Real-Time Dense Reconstruction and Tracking in Endoscopic Surgeries using Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.15124) (2024)<br><br><sub>tracking-slam &middot; explicit &middot; tracking</sub><br><sub>⚠ unverified: datasets, experiments, links, method, resources</sub> | <ol><li>Adjacent work — EndoGSLAM performs camera tracking and incremental tissue mapping with a streamlined Gaussian map.</li><li>Track the endoscope and incrementally reconstruct tissue with a streamlined Gaussian representation and differentiable rasterization, using partial refinement to optimize the expanded map.</li><li>The evaluation includes Quantitative results on the C3VD dataset.</li></ol> |

| **[New]** [SemGauss-SLAM: Dense Semantic Gaussian Splatting SLAM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.07494) (2024)<br><br><sub>tracking-slam &middot; explicit &middot; tracking</sub><br><sub>⚠ unverified: datasets, experiments, links, method, resources</sub> | <ol><li>Adjacent work — The own Gaussian map embeds semantic features and bundle-adjusts camera poses.</li><li>Embed semantic features in isotropic scene Gaussians, render RGB/depth/features, and jointly optimize the map and camera poses with semantic-informed bundle adjustment.</li><li>The evaluation includes Comparison of SLAM accuracy and rendering performance.</li></ol> |
| [4K4D: Real-Time 4D View Synthesis at 4K Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.11448) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://zju3dv.github.io/4k4d/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/zju3dv/4K4D "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>efficiency &middot; multi-view &middot; per-scene &middot; hybrid &middot; real-time</sub> | <ol><li>Adjacent work — 4K4D uses a 4D point-cloud and feature-grid representation with differentiable depth peeling, not Gaussian primitives.</li><li>Introduces a 4D point-cloud representation built on a 4D feature grid and compatible with hardware rasterization.</li><li>Introduces a hybrid appearance model to improve rendering quality while preserving efficiency.</li></ol> |
| [DNA-Rendering: A Diverse Neural Actor Repository for High-Fidelity Human-centric Rendering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.10173) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://dna-rendering.github.io/ "Project page")<br><sub>data-benchmark &middot; multi-view &middot; human &middot; large-model &middot; dataset-release</sub> | <ol><li>Adjacent work — DNA-Rendering is a general human-performance dataset and neural-actor benchmark; it neither proposes nor evaluates a Gaussian-specific temporal representation.</li><li>Introduces a large-scale human-performance repository with more than 1,500 subjects, 5,000 motion sequences, and 67.5 million frames.</li><li>Provides multi-view imagery, videos, keypoints, masks, SMPL-X models, and clothing or accessory assets.</li></ol> |
| [HumanRF: High-Fidelity Neural Radiance Fields for Humans in Motion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.06356) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://actors-hq.com/ "Project page")<br><sub>multi-view-reconstruction &middot; multi-view &middot; human &middot; per-scene &middot; compression &middot; continuous-time</sub> | <ol><li>Adjacent work — HumanRF is a temporally factorized neural radiance-field method and does not use Gaussian primitives.</li><li>Introduces ActorsHQ: 12-megapixel multi-view footage from 160 cameras for 16 human-motion sequences with per-frame meshes.</li><li>Introduces HumanRF, a temporally factorized 4D neural representation for high-fidelity, compressed human-performance playback.</li></ol> |
| [NeRSemble: Multi-view Radiance Field Reconstruction of Human Heads](https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.03027) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://tobias-kirschstein.github.io/nersemble "Project page")<br><sub>data-benchmark &middot; dataset &middot; multi-view &middot; human &middot; benchmark</sub> | <ol><li>Supporting resource — NeRSemble contains no Gaussian primitives: the representation is an Instant-NGP radiance field with a deformation field and an ensemble of hash grids (include/04_method.tex:40-72, eq:feature_blending and eq:canonical_feature_blending).</li><li>A 16-camera calibrated, PTP-synchronized capture rig recording human heads at 7.1 MP and 73 fps, and a dataset of 4734 sequences of 222 subjects covering expressions, emotions, hair motion and speech.</li><li>A dynamic head reconstruction method (NeRSemble) that combines a deformation field with an ensemble of multi-resolution hash encodings blended by per-timestep weights, evaluated on the new benchmark.</li></ol> |
| [NeRF-DS: Neural Radiance Fields for Dynamic Specular Objects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2303.14435) (2023)<br><br><sub>data-benchmark &middot; dataset &middot; monocular &middot; per-scene &middot; benchmark</sub> | <ol><li>Supporting resource — NeRF-DS contains no Gaussian scene primitives: the representation is an MLP radiance field built on HyperNeRF (Arxiv_Paper.tex:132, 192-284), and the five occurrences of the word "Gaussian" in the source are a Gaussian filter applied to mask rendering weights (Arxiv_Paper.tex:415) and a smoothing kernel in an ablation (line 552), not primitives.</li><li>A dynamic specular scene dataset of eight everyday scenes captured by two rigidly mounted forward-facing cameras, one used for training and the other for testing, which is the catalog's `nerf-ds` record (Arxiv_Paper.tex:325, 600-618).</li><li>A surface-aware dynamic NeRF that conditions each warped point's colour on its observation-space coordinate and surface normal, so corresponding points sharing canonical geometry may still reflect different colours (Arxiv_Paper.tex:121-123, 197).</li></ol> |
| [Streaming Radiance Fields for 3D Video Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2210.14831) (2022)<br><br>[![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/AlgoHunt/StreamRF "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>efficiency &middot; dataset &middot; multi-view &middot; explicit &middot; streaming &middot; fast-training</sub> | <ol><li>Supporting resource — StreamRF contains no Gaussian primitives: it is a Plenoxels-style sparse voxel grid with spherical harmonics, updated by per-frame grid differences (method.tex eq:plenoxel line 67, eq:grid_addition line 84).</li><li>An incremental, explicit-grid formulation of dynamic radiance fields: a base model is adapted frame by frame through a trained per-frame model difference, tuned only within a narrow band around occupied voxels.</li><li>Difference-based compression of the per-frame grid deltas and a downsampled pilot model that guides full-scale tuning, giving about 15 s per-frame training on an RTX 3090 with small storage.</li></ol> |
| [Monocular Dynamic View Synthesis: A Reality Check](https://arxiv.org/abs/2210.13445) (2022)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://kair-bair.github.io/dycheck/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/KAIR-BAIR/dycheck "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>data-benchmark &middot; monocular &middot; tracking &middot; dataset-release &middot; evaluation-study</sub> | <ol><li>Adjacent work — This is a general monocular dynamic-view benchmark and dataset predating 3DGS, not a Gaussian-specific evaluation.</li><li>Identifies multi-view signal leakage in dynamic-view-synthesis evaluation and defines effective multi-view factors for capture sequences.</li><li>Introduces co-visibility-masked image metrics and correspondence accuracy for evaluation.</li></ol> |
| [NeuMan: Neural Human Radiance Field from a Single Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2203.12575) (2022)<br><br>[![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/apple/ml-neuman "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>data-benchmark &middot; dataset &middot; monocular &middot; human &middot; per-scene</sub> | <ol><li>Supporting resource — NeuMan contains no Gaussian primitives: both models are NeRFs (tex/3_method.tex:41-54 scene NeRF, 91-130 human NeRF with eq:humannerf_cs).</li><li>A framework that trains a scene NeRF and a pose-driven human NeRF from a single in-the-wild video, with the human modelled in a Da-pose canonical space reached through an SMPL-driven volume warping field.</li><li>End-to-end SMPL optimization and an error-correction network that let training proceed from erroneous human geometry estimates, plus composition of human and scene models for telegathering.</li></ol> |
| [Efficient Neural Radiance Fields for Interactive Free-viewpoint Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2112.01517) (2021)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://zju3dv.github.io/enerf/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/zju3dv/EasyVolcap "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>efficiency &middot; multi-view &middot; feed-forward &middot; depth-prior &middot; real-time</sub> | <ol><li>Adjacent work — ENeRF is a neural radiance-field method for free-viewpoint video and does not use Gaussian primitives.</li><li>Builds cascade cost volumes from multi-view images to predict coarse geometry.</li><li>Samples near predicted surfaces to reduce empty-space evaluation for interactive free-viewpoint video.</li></ol> |
| [HyperNeRF: A Higher-Dimensional Representation for Topologically Varying Neural Radiance Fields](https://arxiv.org/abs/2106.13228) (2021)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://hypernerf.github.io/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/google/hypernerf "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>monocular-reconstruction &middot; monocular &middot; per-scene &middot; continuous-time</sub> | <ol><li>Adjacent work — HyperNeRF models dynamic scenes as a higher-dimensional neural radiance field, not Gaussian splats.</li><li>Models topologically varying dynamic scenes by lifting a NeRF into a higher-dimensional hyperspace.</li><li>Represents each observed configuration as a slice through a 5D radiance field, avoiding discontinuous deformation mappings.</li></ol> |
| [Neural 3D Video Synthesis from Multi-view Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2103.02597) (2021)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://neural-3d-video.github.io/ "Project page")<br><sub>multi-view-reconstruction &middot; multi-view &middot; per-scene &middot; compression &middot; continuous-time</sub> | <ol><li>Adjacent work — Neural 3D Video uses a time-conditioned NeRF and latent codes rather than Gaussian primitives.</li><li>Represents dynamic multi-view video with a time-conditioned NeRF and compact latent codes.</li><li>Uses hierarchical training and ray importance sampling to improve training speed and perceptual quality.</li></ol> |
| [Neural Body: Implicit Neural Representations with Structured Latent Codes for Novel View Synthesis of Dynamic Humans](https://arxiv.org/abs/2012.15838) (2020)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://zju3dv.github.io/neuralbody/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/zju3dv/neuralbody "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>sparse-reconstruction &middot; multi-view &middot; human &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; per-scene &middot; sparse-view</sub> | <ol><li>Adjacent work — Neural Body is an implicit neural human representation without Gaussian primitives.</li><li>Introduces a deformable-mesh-anchored latent representation that integrates observations across video frames for sparse-view human synthesis.</li><li>Releases ZJU-MoCap, a multi-view dataset of performers with complex motions.</li></ol> |
| [D-NeRF: Neural Radiance Fields for Dynamic Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2011.13961) (2020)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://www.albertpumarola.com/research/D-NeRF/index.html "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/albertpumarola/D-NeRF "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>monocular-reconstruction &middot; monocular &middot; per-scene &middot; continuous-time</sub> | <ol><li>Adjacent work — D-NeRF is a dynamic neural radiance field with canonical deformation, not Gaussian splatting.</li><li>Extends NeRF to dynamic scenes by making time an input and learning canonicalization and time-specific deformation mappings.</li><li>Reconstructs rigid, articulated, and non-rigid motion from a moving monocular camera.</li></ol> |
| [Novel View Synthesis of Dynamic Scenes With Globally Coherent Depths From a Monocular Camera](https://arxiv.org/abs/2004.01294) (2020)<br><br><sub>data-benchmark &middot; dataset &middot; monocular &middot; self-supervised &middot; depth-prior</sub><br><sub>⚠ unverified: experiments</sub> | <ol><li>Supporting resource — Contains no Gaussian primitives: its representation is a fused per-view depth map (DFNet, egbib.tex:978-1030) rendered by warping plus a CNN blender (egbib.tex:1162-1210).</li><li>A self-supervised depth fusion network (DFNet) that corrects the scale of single-view depth against multi-view-stereo depth to give complete, view-invariant depth of a dynamic scene from a monocular camera.</li><li>A DeepBlender rendering network, trained adversarially, that composites warped foreground and background and fills missing regions to synthesize a photorealistic view at a chosen location and time.</li></ol> |

## Evaluation studies

These papers center controlled analysis, diagnostic evaluation, benchmark protocols, or
comparative studies. Some also introduce targeted mitigations or release evaluation data.

| [Sparse Light Field Sampling Improves Casual 3D and 4D Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.20602) (2026)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://shamus.li/lightfield-gaussian-splatting "Project page")<br><sub>data-benchmark &middot; dataset &middot; benchmark &middot; evaluation-study &middot; multi-view &middot; sparse-view</sub><br><sub>⚠ unverified: experiments</sub> | <ol><li>Collects and releases two real-world multi-camera datasets of 16 scenes, 8 static and 8 dynamic, each recorded simultaneously by an iPhone 15 Pro, an Apple Vision Pro stereo pair and a Lytro Illum (sec/4_experiments.tex:9-12).</li><li>Benchmarks off-the-shelf 3DGS, 4DGS, FSGS and SparseGS across those cameras by exposure count and angular baseline; its largest margin is dynamic 4DGS, iPhone PSNR 24.51 to 31.71 (tables/exposure-limited-dynamic.tex:11-13).</li><li>Introduces a multiplexed light field camera whose sub-lens images overlap on the sensor, disentangled by simulating the superposition forward model on rasterized Gaussians with a total-variation term (sec/3_benchmark.tex:31-39).</li></ol> |
| [Bringing a Personal Point of View: Evaluating Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting for Egocentric Scene Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.23803) (2026)<br><br><sub>data-benchmark &middot; monocular &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; human &middot; robotics &middot; evaluation-study</sub> | <ol><li>Evaluates dynamic monocular 3DGS models on egocentric and exocentric video using paired ego-exo recordings from the EgoExo4D dataset.</li><li>Finds that reconstruction quality is consistently lower in egocentric views.</li><li>Analysis reveals that the difference in reconstruction quality, measured in peak signal-to-noise ratio, stems from the reconstruction of static, not dynamic, content.</li></ol> |
| [Does it matter which Gaussians you pick in 4D Gaussian streaming?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.17227) (2026)<br><br><sub>data-benchmark &middot; streaming &middot; native-4dgs &middot; benchmark &middot; evaluation-study</sub> | <ol><li>Holds Instant Gaussian Stream fixed and sweeps five anchor samplers across budgets and refinement settings on N3DV and MeetingRoom.</li><li>Finds random or uniform sampling with 4,096 anchors matches farthest-point sampling with 8,192 anchors within measurement error and releases the sweep as a sampler benchmark.</li></ol> |
| [Style4D-Bench: A Benchmark Suite for 4D Stylization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.19243) (2025)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://becky-catherine.github.io/Style4D "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Becky-catherine/Style4D-Bench "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>data-benchmark &middot; multi-view &middot; native-4dgs &middot; editing &middot; benchmark &middot; evaluation-study</sub><br><sub>⚠ unverified: method</sub> | <ol><li>Defines a benchmark suite for standardized evaluation of 4D stylization.</li><li>Couples a base 4DGS scene representation with per-Gaussian MLPs for temporally and spatially aware appearance control.</li></ol> |

## Datasets

Papers that release data are linked from their dataset row. **Access** distinguishes public,
application-gated, restricted, and unreleased data. **4DGS use** counts unique, visible arXiv
papers verified as direct dynamic-Gaussian work that use the dataset for training or evaluation;
`introduced` means the dataset has not yet been reused as a benchmark.
Licenses describe dataset terms where available. Repository-only licenses are explicitly
labeled and do not imply a dataset license.
